Domain: money. Mode: an attitude.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to money, each in the form of an attitude (an attitude the person holds, as opposed to something they do as a rule, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read this as traits of a person's money attitude: how they hold money, spend it, fear losing it, or feel about wealth, not how they handle a specific transaction. I included admirable and unadmirable dispositions, and some phrases with no single-word name.",
"items": [
{"label": "frugal", "gloss": "This means preferring to spend little and avoid waste, even when money is not tight.", "antonym": "extravagant", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.9},
{"label": "miserly", "gloss": "This means hoarding money and resenting nearly every expense, even small or shared ones.", "antonym": "generous", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.8},
{"label": "spendthrift", "gloss": "This means spending freely and carelessly, with little regard for saving or future needs.", "antonym": "thrifty", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
{"label": "penny-pinching", "gloss": "This means counting small sums closely and refusing to pay more than necessary, even when it costs others.", "antonym": "open-handed", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
{"label": "keeping up appearances", "gloss": "This means spending mainly to look successful to others and matching the lifestyle of one's peers.", "antonym": "indifferent to status", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.6},
{"label": "generous to a fault", "gloss": "This means giving money away so readily that it harms the giver's own security or obligations.", "antonym": "stingy", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "covetous", "gloss": "This means persistently wanting what others have, especially money, possessions, or status.", "antonym": "content with what they have", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
{"label": "speculative", "gloss": "This means willing to put savings into uncertain bets in hope of large returns.", "antonym": "cautious with savings", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
{"label": "open-handed", "gloss": "This means sharing money readily and paying generously without keeping close track of who owes what.", "antonym": "tight-fisted", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
{"label": "scarcity-minded", "gloss": "This means believing money is always about to run out, so one holds back and worries despite having enough.", "antonym": "abundance-minded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "future-oriented", "gloss": "This means deferring spending and setting money aside for later needs rather than enjoying it now.", "antonym": "present-focused", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "loss-averse", "gloss": "This means feeling the pain of losing money far more strongly than the pleasure of an equal gain.", "antonym": "gain-seeking", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "money-shy", "gloss": "This means feeling awkward about discussing, asking for, or openly handling one's own money.", "antonym": "unembarrassed about money", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "scrupulously honest with money", "gloss": "This means reporting money matters truthfully and paying what is owed, even when concealment would be easy.", "antonym": "shady with money", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "feels entitled to money", "gloss": "This means believing one deserves financial gains or support from others without needing to earn or justify them.", "antonym": "grateful for what they receive", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "cavalier about debt", "gloss": "This means taking on borrowing lightly and assuming it will sort itself out without serious planning.", "antonym": "scrupulous about debt", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "stoic about losses", "gloss": "This means accepting financial setbacks calmly and refusing to dwell on money that has been lost.", "antonym": "fixated on losses", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1}
]}

Domain: money. Mode: a habit.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to money, each in the form of a habit (something the person does as a rule, as opposed to an attitude they hold, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read the constraint as everyday money-handling routines a person follows as a rule: how they spend, save, give, borrow, split bills and check their accounts. I left out attitudes toward money, moral stances, and ways of talking about it.",
"items": [
{"label": "lives below means", "gloss": "This means keeping spending well under income as a standing rule, so a surplus builds up every month.", "antonym": "lives beyond means", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.72},
{"label": "saves before spending", "gloss": "This means setting aside a portion of each paycheck first, before any discretionary purchases are made.", "antonym": "spends before saving", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.68},
{"label": "gives generously", "gloss": "This means handing over money or gifts readily and without counting the cost to oneself.", "antonym": "tight-fisted", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.66},
{"label": "buys on impulse", "gloss": "This means making purchases on the spur of the moment, without a delay or a comparison with other options.", "antonym": "deliberates before buying", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.62},
{"label": "tracks every expense", "gloss": "This means recording each outgoing payment and reviewing the running totals regularly.", "antonym": "loses count of spending", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.58},
{"label": "haggles at every purchase", "gloss": "This means asking for a lower price as a routine step, even for ordinary items and small sums.", "antonym": "pays the asking price", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "picks up the tab", "gloss": "This means habitually paying the bill when eating or drinking with others, whether or not the cost was agreed beforehand.", "antonym": "lets others pay", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.46},
{"label": "avoids credit cards", "gloss": "This means refusing to use revolving credit for everyday purchases, paying only with cash, debit or money already held.", "antonym": "carries revolving balances", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
{"label": "hoards money", "gloss": "This means keeping cash or savings tightly held and spending very little, even when spending would be reasonable.", "antonym": "spends freely", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.36},
{"label": "borrows against the future", "gloss": "This means taking on loans or advances to pay for present wants, relying on income that has not yet arrived.", "antonym": "pays as it goes", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "avoids checking accounts", "gloss": "This means leaving bank statements and balances unopened for long stretches, even when bills or problems are likely.", "antonym": "reviews finances weekly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.27},
{"label": "tips lavishly", "gloss": "This means leaving tips well above the customary amount as a rule, in every service setting.", "antonym": "tips sparingly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.23},
{"label": "prepays debts early", "gloss": "This means paying off loans or balances ahead of schedule as a standing practice, whenever spare money is available.", "antonym": "pays only the minimum", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "splits costs to the cent", "gloss": "This means insisting that shared expenses be divided exactly, down to the last cent, among everyone who took part.", "antonym": "covers others' shares", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.16},
{"label": "reinvests windfalls", "gloss": "This means putting unexpected gains such as bonuses or inheritances back into savings or investments rather than spending them.", "antonym": "spends windfalls at once", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "automates transfers", "gloss": "This means setting up recurring automatic movements of money to savings or bills, so the decision is made once rather than repeatedly.", "antonym": "transfers only when reminded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.09},
{"label": "chases quick returns", "gloss": "This means repeatedly seeking fast, high gains from speculative bets, moving money often in pursuit of short-term profit.", "antonym": "invests patiently", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.05}
]}

text:
{"approach": "I read the constraint as habitual money behaviors that a persona could repeat as a standing pattern, covering both disciplined and damaging ones, and I avoided attitudes, feelings and one-off acts. Each label names a rule the person follows with money.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "tracks every expense", "gloss": "This means the person records and reviews each purchase so they always know where their money has gone.", "antonym": "ignores where money goes", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
  {"label": "pays off balances in full", "gloss": "This means the person clears credit card and other balances completely each month rather than letting interest build up.", "antonym": "carries balances month to month", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "haggles over every price", "gloss": "This means the person bargains as a matter of course, even where the seller has not invited it, to pay less.", "antonym": "accepts the asking price", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
  {"label": "gives a fixed share away", "gloss": "This means the person sets aside a set portion of income for giving and donates it on a schedule, whatever else is happening.", "antonym": "gives only when asked", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "hides purchases from partner", "gloss": "This means the person routinely conceals spending from a partner, keeping purchases and debts out of sight.", "antonym": "discloses every purchase", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "buys to soothe moods", "gloss": "This means the person reliably turns to shopping as a way to lift their spirits or calm themselves down.", "antonym": "resists shopping urges", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "waits a day before big purchases", "gloss": "This means the person deliberately delays any large expense for at least a day to test whether the want lasts.", "antonym": "buys on the spot", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "always covers the bill", "gloss": "This means the person habitually pays for the group's meals and outings, often without discussing it with others.", "antonym": "never offers to pay", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "feigns poverty to dodge costs", "gloss": "This means the person pretends to have less money than they do so that others will cover shared expenses.", "antonym": "shares costs without complaint", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
  {"label": "cedes money decisions to others", "gloss": "This means the person consistently hands over financial choices to a partner or relative and does not weigh in.", "antonym": "takes charge of finances", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "buys status symbols", "gloss": "This means the person regularly chooses costly branded goods mainly for how they signal rank or success to others.", "antonym": "ignores status goods", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "lives beyond means", "gloss": "This means the person routinely spends more than they earn and covers the gap with loans or credit as a standing practice.", "antonym": "lives within means", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "chases hot tips", "gloss": "This means the person moves savings into whatever investment is currently being talked up, without researching its basis.", "antonym": "sticks to understood holdings", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "spends windfalls at once", "gloss": "This means the person spends bonuses, gifts or unexpected sums right away instead of saving or investing them.", "antonym": "banks windfalls untouched", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "discusses money openly", "gloss": "This means the person talks plainly about finances with family and friends, sharing incomes, debts and plans without embarrassment.", "antonym": "keeps finances private", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
  {"label": "ledgers loans to friends", "gloss": "This means the person records every sum lent to others in writing, with repayment dates, and presses for repayment on schedule.", "antonym": "lends without records", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.05},
  {"label": "hoards cash", "gloss": "This means the person habitually keeps large amounts of physical cash at home rather than in banks or investments.", "antonym": "keeps little cash on hand", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1}
 ]}

{"approach": "I read 'money' as the domain and 'habit' as a standing rule of conduct: things a person routinely does with cash, bills, purchases, debts and investments, not attitudes, feelings or moral stances. I included both admirable and unadmirable habits and several without a single common word.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "pays bills promptly", "gloss": "This means settling invoices and bills as soon as they arrive, as a fixed rule rather than when reminded.", "antonym": "pays bills late", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.8},
  {"label": "tracks every expense", "gloss": "This means recording each small purchase and fee so that the person always knows where the money went.", "antonym": "never tracks spending", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
  {"label": "keeps a written budget", "gloss": "This means drafting a plan for income and outgoings each month and checking actual spending against it.", "antonym": "keeps no budget", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.65},
  {"label": "buys on impulse", "gloss": "This means making purchases the moment a want appears, often without comparing options or weighing the cost.", "antonym": "sleeps on big purchases", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.75},
  {"label": "haggles over prices", "gloss": "This means routinely negotiating a lower price, even for ordinary goods and services where the seller expects it.", "antonym": "accepts asking prices", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "tips lavishly", "gloss": "This means regularly leaving a tip well above the customary amount, even when the service was ordinary.", "antonym": "tips the bare minimum", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "splits costs to the cent", "gloss": "This means insisting that shared expenses be divided exactly, with each person paying only their own share.", "antonym": "picks up the tab", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "lends without collecting", "gloss": "This means handing money to others and letting the debt go unpaid, rarely asking for it back.", "antonym": "insists on repayment", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
  {"label": "gives a fixed share", "gloss": "This means setting aside a set proportion of income for others on a regular schedule, regardless of how one feels that month.", "antonym": "gives on a whim", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "shops when stressed", "gloss": "This means turning to buying things as a routine way of coping with anxiety, boredom or low spirits.", "antonym": "shops only for needs", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "chases losses", "gloss": "This means doubling down on a bad bet or investment in an effort to recover what was already lost, instead of stopping.", "antonym": "cuts losses early", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "hides finances from others", "gloss": "This means routinely concealing income, debts or purchases from a partner or family, even when it affects shared decisions.", "antonym": "shares finances openly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "hoards cash at home", "gloss": "This means keeping large sums in physical notes rather than in a bank, out of distrust of institutions or a wish to stay liquid.", "antonym": "banks surplus at once", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
  {"label": "reads contracts closely", "gloss": "This means going through the fine print of every agreement, loan or subscription before signing, however long it is.", "antonym": "signs without reading", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "rebalances portfolio yearly", "gloss": "This means reviewing investments once a year and restoring the intended mix of assets by selling and buying to match it.", "antonym": "never rebalances", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
  {"label": "saves before spending", "gloss": "This means setting money aside for savings first, as soon as income arrives, and only then deciding what is left to spend.", "antonym": "spends before saving", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55}
 ]}

 "items": [

  {"label": "pride in possessions", "gloss": "This means taking satisfaction in what one owns and deriving a sense of self-worth from one's belongings.", "antonym": "detached from possessions", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},

  {"label": "scarcity-minded", "gloss": "This means seeing money as always in short supply, and planning as though there will never be enough.", "antonym": "abundance-minded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},

  {"label": "values-driven spending", "gloss": "This means choosing purchases according to ethical principles and refusing to buy from sources one judges wrong.", "antonym": "indifferent to provenance", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "meritocratic about wealth", "gloss": "This means believing that riches reflect personal effort and talent, and that the poor have earned their lot.", "antonym": "fatalistic about wealth", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},

text:
{"approach": "I read the constraint as attitudes toward the end of life: fear, acceptance, denial, grief, and the stance taken toward one's own finitude and others' deaths. I kept each label to a stance rather than a ritual, habit or speech pattern.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "unafraid of the end", "gloss": "This means facing one's own ending without dread, feeling no anxiety when it comes up in thought or conversation.", "antonym": "afraid of the end", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.85},
  {"label": "stoic in the face of the end", "gloss": "This means meeting one's own mortality with composed endurance, refusing to show or feel panic while accepting that it cannot be avoided.", "antonym": "panicky in the face of the end", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.8},
  {"label": "resigned to mortality", "gloss": "This means having settled into the belief that one's life will end, with a weary acceptance that resists no longer.", "antonym": "defiant against the inevitable", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
  {"label": "death-denying", "gloss": "This means refusing to admit that one will die, and steering thought away from the subject as if it could be kept at bay.", "antonym": "death-accepting", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "morbidly preoccupied with mortality", "gloss": "This means dwelling repeatedly on death and decay, returning to thoughts of the end whatever else is happening.", "antonym": null, "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
  {"label": "callous toward others' losses", "gloss": "This means feeling little when others die or lose people, treating their bereavement as someone else's business.", "antonym": "tender toward others' losses", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "avoids mourning rituals", "gloss": "This means turning away from funerals, wakes and memorials, finding such observances pointless or too painful to join.", "antonym": "lingers in grief", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "at peace with the end", "gloss": "This means feeling settled about one's eventual death, with a calm sense that it fits into the course of a life.", "antonym": "at odds with the end", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55},
  {"label": "longs for release", "gloss": "This means wishing for death as relief from suffering or weariness, and speaking of it as a welcome rest.", "antonym": "clings to life", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "values a dignified exit", "gloss": "This means caring deeply about how one's life ends, wanting control, privacy and self-respect in the final stage.", "antonym": "indifferent to how one exits", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "fatalistic about one's fate", "gloss": "This means believing that what happens at the end is predetermined, so that effort to shape one's own ending seems futile.", "antonym": "determined to shape one's fate", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "relishes the macabre", "gloss": "This means enjoying grim, morbid material about death, such as gruesome stories, graveyards and the details of decay, for its own sake.", "antonym": "averts gaze from the macabre", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "shuns reminders of mortality", "gloss": "This means steering clear of anything that brings one's own finitude to mind, such as illness talk, obituaries or aging signs.", "antonym": "seeks reminders of mortality", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "imagines themselves immortal", "gloss": "This means acting and planning as though one's own life will go on indefinitely, treating the end as a remote possibility not worth considering.", "antonym": "accepts being finite", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "treats life as provisional", "gloss": "This means regarding one's time as temporary and borrowed, so that commitments and pleasures are held loosely against an impending end.", "antonym": "treats life as permanent", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "sees the end as instructive", "gloss": "This means believing that facing death teaches something about how to live, and welcoming mortality as a source of insight.", "antonym": "sees the end as meaningless", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "sure of an afterlife", "gloss": "This means holding firm confidence that some form of existence continues after the body dies, and letting this shape one's outlook on loss.", "antonym": "doubtful of any afterlife", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "unsentimental about passing", "gloss": "This means viewing the departure of people and of oneself in matter-of-fact terms, without dwelling on its emotional or symbolic weight.", "antonym": "sentimental about passing", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3}
 ]}

{"approach": "I read the constraint as ways a person talks about what they know or don't know, such as how they signal certainty, handle their own ignorance, cite others, correct or teach, and treat rivals' ideas. Each item is a lasting speaking style rather than a single remark, mood, or skill.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "admits ignorance readily", "gloss": "This means saying plainly and without embarrassment when they do not know something, rather than covering the gap.", "antonym": "bluffs when unsure", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
  {"label": "bluffs when unsure", "gloss": "This means answering confidently and fluently even when they lack the facts, so that their ignorance is hidden from listeners.", "antonym": "admits ignorance readily", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "overstates certainty", "gloss": "This means presenting tentative conclusions as settled, speaking with more confidence in claims than the evidence supports.", "antonym": "qualifies claims carefully", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "qualifies claims carefully", "gloss": "This means marking the limits, uncertainty, and likely exceptions of what they assert so listeners can judge how far to trust it.", "antonym": "overstates certainty", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "name-drops authorities", "gloss": "This means slipping in the names of famous experts or prestigious sources to lend weight to their own statements.", "antonym": "cites no authorities", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "lectures unprompted", "gloss": "This means launching into extended explanations that nobody asked for, treating conversation as an occasion to teach.", "antonym": "answers only what is asked", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55},
  {"label": "speaks in jargon", "gloss": "This means habitually using specialist terms and technical phrasing, even with listeners who do not share the vocabulary.", "antonym": "plain-spoken about ideas", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "pedantically corrects others", "gloss": "This means pointing out small factual or wording errors in other people's speech, often when the mistake does not matter to the point.", "antonym": "lets small errors pass", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "asks clarifying questions", "gloss": "This means regularly pressing for definitions, scope, and sources before accepting a claim, so the meaning is pinned down first.", "antonym": "assumes understanding", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "answers with questions", "gloss": "This means replying to a direct question with another question, often to avoid committing to an answer or to make the other person reason it out.", "antonym": "answers directly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "thinks out loud", "gloss": "This means voicing half-formed reasoning as it happens, showing the steps and doubts instead of delivering only finished conclusions.", "antonym": "speaks only in conclusions", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "concedes points gracefully", "gloss": "This means readily acknowledging when someone has made a better argument or a correct fact, and saying so without sulking.", "antonym": "defends every point", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "restates rivals charitably", "gloss": "This means summarizing an opposing view in its strongest form before replying to it, so the reply engages the view actually held.", "antonym": "restates rivals uncharitably", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "hides behind citations", "gloss": "This means piling up references and quotations in place of stating and defending their own reasoning, so that the sources do the arguing.", "antonym": "argues from own reasoning", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
  {"label": "talks down to listeners", "gloss": "This means explaining things in a tone that implies the listener is slow or ignorant, even when the explanation is accurate.", "antonym": "explains without condescension", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "withholds what they know", "gloss": "This means keeping useful information to themselves or revealing it only in part, so others depend on them or stay uninformed.", "antonym": "shares freely", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "parades trivia", "gloss": "This means rattling off obscure facts and dates mainly to display how much they know, whether or not the facts bear on the topic.", "antonym": "keeps facts in reserve", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "frames opinions as facts", "gloss": "This means stating personal judgments in the flat tone of established truth, so listeners cannot tell what is opinion and what is known.", "antonym": "marks opinion as opinion", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45}
 ]}

  {"label": "socratic", "gloss": "This means the person steers others toward conclusions by asking probing questions rather than stating what they think.", "antonym": "declarative", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "enigmatic", "gloss": "This means the person speaks in hints and riddles about what they know, leaving listeners to puzzle out the meaning.", "antonym": "plainly direct", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "oracular", "gloss": "This means the person delivers verdicts on questions in a grave, authoritative manner that discourages discussion or challenge.", "antonym": "conversational", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.12},

 ]}

Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to religion, each in the form of an attitude (an attitude the person holds, as opposed to something they do as a rule, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read the constraint as attitudes toward religion itself: reverence, doubt, tolerance, certainty, indifference and the like, as distinct from religious practices, speech habits or moral conduct. I then looked for less obvious dispositions a persona could hold toward faith, including vices.",
"items": [
{"label": "reverent toward the sacred", "gloss": "This means regarding holy things, places and texts with deep respect and a sense of awe that shapes how one stands before them.", "antonym": "irreverent toward the sacred", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.85},
{"label": "devout", "gloss": "This means holding one's faith as the central commitment of life, with conviction that persists through ordinary days and hard ones alike.", "antonym": "irreligious", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.9},
{"label": "zealous", "gloss": "This means feeling intense fervor for one's religion, treating its cause as urgent and personal, sometimes at the expense of patience toward others.", "antonym": "lukewarm", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.75},
{"label": "tolerant of other faiths", "gloss": "This means accepting that people of other religions may be sincere and sharing public life with them without wanting to convert or correct them.", "antonym": "intolerant of other faiths", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
{"label": "superstitious", "gloss": "This means attributing outcomes to luck, omens, charms or unseen forces, and feeling uneasy when ignoring such signs despite lacking evidence for them.", "antonym": "rationally grounded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
{"label": "skeptical of dogma", "gloss": "This means questioning fixed doctrines and testing religious claims against reason or experience rather than accepting them on authority alone.", "antonym": "uncritically accepting of dogma", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55},
{"label": "religiously indifferent", "gloss": "This means caring little whether religion is true or practiced, treating it as something others may pursue while one's own attention goes elsewhere.", "antonym": "religiously engaged", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "sectarian", "gloss": "This means identifying strongly with one faction within a religion and regarding rival branches of the same faith as enemies or illegitimate.", "antonym": "ecumenical", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "self-righteous about belief", "gloss": "This means feeling sure of one's own moral and spiritual superiority because of one's faith, and looking down on those who believe less or differently.", "antonym": "humble about belief", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
{"label": "anticlerical", "gloss": "This means distrusting and opposing the authority of priests, ministers or religious institutions, while not necessarily rejecting faith itself.", "antonym": "deferential to clergy", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
{"label": "humble before the divine", "gloss": "This means accepting that one's understanding of God or the sacred is limited, and holding one's views with modesty and openness to correction.", "antonym": "proud before the divine", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
{"label": "missionary-minded", "gloss": "This means feeling a standing urge to bring others to one's faith and treating their conversion as a worthwhile goal in one's own life.", "antonym": "content to keep faith private", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "rigidly observant", "gloss": "This means keeping religious rules and rituals exactly and regarding deviation from them as a serious matter, however small or inconvenient.", "antonym": "casually observant", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "cynical about religious leaders", "gloss": "This means assuming that clergy and religious figures are mainly driven by power, money or status rather than by the sincere faith they profess.", "antonym": "trusting of religious leaders", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "eclectic about faith", "gloss": "This means drawing beliefs and practices freely from several traditions and combining them into a personal faith without feeling bound to one.", "antonym": "exclusive about faith", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "reads scripture figuratively", "gloss": "This means treating sacred texts as containing symbolic or moral meaning rather than as literal reports, and adjusting their force to context.", "antonym": "takes scripture literally", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "open to mystery", "gloss": "This means accepting that some religious truths cannot be proven or fully grasped, and feeling no need to resolve every question before trusting them.", "antonym": "demands proof of everything", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "scornful of piety", "gloss": "This means mocking or looking down on visible devotion, prayer and outward religiousness as pretense or weakness in others.", "antonym": "respectful of piety", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "credulous of miracles", "gloss": "This means readily believing reports of miracles, visions or healings without demanding much evidence, and passing such reports on as likely true.", "antonym": "miracle-skeptical", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1}
]}

user:
Domain: religion. Mode: an attitude.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to religion, each in the form of an attitude (an attitude the person holds, as opposed to something they do as a rule, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read the constraint as attitudes a person holds toward religion itself: their stance on belief, doubt, practice, other faiths, and the sacred. I excluded behaviors, speech habits, moods, and moral stances, and I looked for attitudes that name less obvious positions, including some with no single common word.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "devout", "gloss": "This means holding one's faith sincerely and steadily, with commitment that shapes daily life and convictions.", "antonym": "irreligious", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.92},
  {"label": "reverent", "gloss": "This means regarding sacred things, texts, or rites with deep respect and a sense of awe.", "antonym": "irreverent", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
  {"label": "zealous in faith", "gloss": "This means holding one's beliefs with fervent, intense ardor that leaves little room for half-measures.", "antonym": "lukewarm in faith", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
  {"label": "dogmatic about doctrine", "gloss": "This means treating religious teachings as fixed truths and refusing to reconsider them whatever the evidence or argument.", "antonym": "open to revising doctrine", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55},
  {"label": "tolerant of other faiths", "gloss": "This means accepting that others hold different religious beliefs and respecting their right to hold them.", "antonym": "intolerant of other faiths", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "eager to convert others", "gloss": "This means feeling a strong urge to win others over to one's own religious beliefs and to see them adopt it.", "antonym": "content to keep beliefs private", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "performatively pious", "gloss": "This means displaying religious devotion mainly to be seen, while holding little real conviction underneath.", "antonym": "sincerely pious", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "superstitious", "gloss": "This means giving credence to omens, charms, or luck-based beliefs that lack rational or doctrinal grounding.", "antonym": "rationally grounded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
  {"label": "credulous of miracles", "gloss": "This means accepting reports of miracles or supernatural events readily, without demanding strong evidence.", "antonym": "skeptical of miracles", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "openly doubting", "gloss": "This means admitting to unresolved doubts about one's faith and talking about them candidly rather than hiding them.", "antonym": "unshakably certain", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "comfortable with uncertainty about God", "gloss": "This means being at ease not knowing whether God exists or what God is like, without needing a firm answer.", "antonym": "demands certainty about God", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "spiritually curious", "gloss": "This means exploring different religious traditions and questions of meaning with open interest, to learn rather than to settle.", "antonym": "spiritually incurious", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "spiritually restless", "gloss": "This means feeling a persistent unease about one's spiritual life and moving on from practice or belief in search of something more.", "antonym": "spiritually settled", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "picks and chooses doctrine", "gloss": "This means accepting some teachings of one's tradition while rejecting others, selecting whatever suits one's own taste.", "antonym": "accepts doctrine whole", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
  {"label": "literal about scripture", "gloss": "This means reading sacred texts as exact historical or factual accounts rather than as symbolic or figurative works.", "antonym": "symbolic about scripture", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "mystically inclined", "gloss": "This means seeking direct, experiential union with the divine and valuing inner encounter over doctrine or institution.", "antonym": "institutionally minded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "scornful of faith", "gloss": "This means regarding religious belief with contempt, treating believers as foolish or deluded.", "antonym": "respectful of faith", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
  {"label": "complacently faithful", "gloss": "This means holding inherited belief without examining it, feeling no need to question it or deepen it.", "antonym": "questioning in faith", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12}
 ]}

Domain: luck. Mode: a habit.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to luck, each in the form of a habit (something the person does as a rule, as opposed to an attitude they hold, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read 'a habit about luck' as a standing, repeated way of responding to good or bad fortune, chance, and others' luck, such as how one credits or blames outcomes, handles windfalls, or acts on risk. I kept items to rules a person follows rather than attitudes or single events.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "counts blessings daily", "gloss": "This means regularly taking stock of good fortune and naming what has gone right, as a set routine.", "antonym": "dwells on grievances", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "attributes success to luck", "gloss": "This means habitually explaining one's achievements mainly as the result of good fortune rather than one's own effort.", "antonym": "credits own effort", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "knocks on wood", "gloss": "This means performing small superstitious rituals as a rule, to ward off bad outcomes or keep good ones in place.", "antonym": "ignores omens", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
  {"label": "tempts fate", "gloss": "This means habitually pushing one's luck, taking chances as though good fortune will keep holding.", "antonym": "avoids needless risk", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55},
  {"label": "seizes the opening", "gloss": "This means reliably acting quickly when a chance appears, rather than waiting for certainty or permission.", "antonym": "lets chances pass", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "chases losses", "gloss": "This means habitually doubling down after a loss, hoping that luck will turn back in one's favor.", "antonym": "cuts losses early", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "shares windfalls", "gloss": "This means regularly giving part of one's unexpected gains to others who have less or who helped.", "antonym": "hoards windfalls", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "blames setbacks on chance", "gloss": "This means habitually treating one's failures as bad luck, so that one's own choices seem not to have caused them.", "antonym": "owns setbacks", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "conceals good breaks", "gloss": "This means habitually keeping quiet about one's lucky turns, to avoid envy or to avoid tempting fate.", "antonym": "boasts of good breaks", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
  {"label": "carries talismans", "gloss": "This means keeping charms or lucky objects on one's person and relying on them in uncertain situations.", "antonym": "scorns talismans", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "discounts own fortune", "gloss": "This means habitually feeling that one's good luck is undeserved and waving it away, as though it did not really count.", "antonym": "claims credit freely", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "rails against misfortune", "gloss": "This means habitually cursing or raging at bad luck when it strikes, as though the world had wronged one personally.", "antonym": "accepts misfortune calmly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "waits to be favored", "gloss": "This means habitually leaving outcomes to chance or to others' goodwill rather than creating one's own openings.", "antonym": "makes own openings", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "plays long shots", "gloss": "This means habitually betting on improbable outcomes, accepting frequent small losses for the hope of a big win.", "antonym": "plays it safe", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "hedges against mishap", "gloss": "This means habitually preparing for bad luck in advance, with reserves, backups, or insurance, as a matter of routine.", "antonym": "ignores contingencies", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "sees patterns in coincidence", "gloss": "This means habitually reading meaning, signs, or design into chance events and unrelated occurrences.", "antonym": "treats coincidence as noise", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "pardons the unfortunate", "gloss": "This means habitually excusing people whose bad outcomes seem to come from circumstance, rather than judging them for it.", "antonym": "judges the unlucky harshly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
  {"label": "finds silver linings", "gloss": "This means habitually looking for something good in setbacks and reframing misfortune as a chance or lesson.", "antonym": "dwells on the downside", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
  {"label": "envies others' jackpots", "gloss": "This means habitually resenting people whose good fortune seems larger or more undeserved than one's own.", "antonym": "celebrates others' jackpots", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "defers to destiny", "gloss": "This means habitually accepting outcomes as preordained and not worth trying to influence, even when one could act.", "antonym": "insists on agency", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5}
 ]}

Domain: religion. Mode: a habit.

Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read 'habit' as a rule the person keeps in their religious life, such as set times of prayer, attendance, fasting or giving, and I excluded beliefs, speech, feelings and moral stances. I included admirable and unadmirable habits and some without a common single word.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "faithful in attendance", "gloss": "This means the person goes to religious services as a rule and rarely misses one without a serious reason.", "antonym": "irregular in attendance", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.8},
  {"label": "punctual in prayer", "gloss": "This means the person prays at set times each day as a fixed routine, whatever their other commitments.", "antonym": "lax in prayer", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
  {"label": "reads scripture daily", "gloss": "This means the person reads sacred texts every day as a settled practice rather than only when moved to.", "antonym": "neglects scripture", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
  {"label": "says grace at meals", "gloss": "This means the person says a blessing before eating as a rule, at home and in public.", "antonym": "eats without grace", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "observes dietary laws", "gloss": "This means the person follows the food restrictions of their faith consistently in every meal and setting.", "antonym": "ignores dietary laws", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "fasts on schedule", "gloss": "This means the person abstains from food on the days their tradition prescribes, year after year, without skipping them.", "antonym": "fasts at whim", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "honors the sabbath", "gloss": "This means the person sets aside the holy day as a rule, avoiding ordinary work and business during it.", "antonym": "works through the sabbath", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "proselytizes unprompted", "gloss": "This means the person routinely approaches strangers to invite them to their faith, whether or not they were asked.", "antonym": "never proselytizes", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "tithes by rule", "gloss": "This means the person gives a fixed share of their income to the religious community at regular intervals.", "antonym": "gives irregularly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "gives alms in secret", "gloss": "This means the person gives to the needy as a standing practice and avoids letting anyone know about it.", "antonym": "gives alms publicly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "examines conscience nightly", "gloss": "This means the person reviews the day each evening against their religious standards as a fixed habit.", "antonym": "skips self-examination", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "confesses regularly", "gloss": "This means the person confesses their faults to a priest or to God on a set schedule rather than only in crisis.", "antonym": "avoids confession", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "keeps night vigils", "gloss": "This means the person stays awake in prayer through part of the night on set occasions as a standing practice.", "antonym": "sleeps through vigils", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "daily contemplative silence", "gloss": "This means the person sits in quiet, wordless prayer or meditation every day as a regular discipline.", "antonym": "never sits in silent prayer", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "makes regular pilgrimages", "gloss": "This means the person travels to sacred sites on a recurring basis as a settled part of their religious life.", "antonym": "never visits shrines", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
  {"label": "wears religious dress daily", "gloss": "This means the person dresses in the garments or markers of their faith every day, in public and private.", "antonym": "dresses without religious markers", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
  {"label": "bargains with God", "gloss": "This means the person routinely makes conditional vows to God, promising a return for a favor, and expects it to be honored.", "antonym": "asks without conditions", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1}
 ]}

"items": [
{"label": "keeps a ledger of favors", "gloss": "This means tallying what each friend has done and owed, and expecting the balance to be settled in time.", "antonym": "lets favors go unrecorded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
{"label": "plays friends against each other", "gloss": "This means setting friends in rivalry or feeding them rival stories to gain standing or keep control over the group.", "antonym": "keeps friends united in trust", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "keeps friends at arm's length", "gloss": "This means staying emotionally distant from friends so that they never get close enough to know the real self.", "antonym": "opens up to friends readily", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "showers new friends with attention", "gloss": "This means lavishing warmth, gifts and praise on a new acquaintance early, then tapering off once the bond feels settled.", "antonym": "warms to friends slowly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "drifts away without a word", "gloss": "This means letting a friendship lapse by slowly withdrawing contact rather than ending it openly or explaining why.", "antonym": "ends friendships with candor", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
{"label": "offers help before being asked", "gloss": "This means noticing a friend's need and stepping in with practical help unprompted, rather than waiting for a request.", "antonym": "waits to be asked for help", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55},
{"label": "shields friends from consequences", "gloss": "This means repeatedly covering for a friend's mistakes or lies so that they never face the results of their own conduct.", "antonym": "lets friends face their own consequences", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "tells friends hard truths", "gloss": "This means giving a friend honest and unwelcome criticism, even when it risks the friendship, because the friend is better served by it.", "antonym": "softens truths for friends", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "collects acquaintances widely", "gloss": "This means maintaining a large circle of loose contacts and actively adding more, while keeping few ties deep.", "antonym": "keeps a small circle of friends", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "remembers friends' small details", "gloss": "This means keeping track of a friend's passing worries, plans and preferences, then bringing them up later to show care.", "antonym": "forgets friends' small details", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "returns favors in kind", "gloss": "This means matching each favor from a friend with one of similar size and timing, so that neither side is left in debt.", "antonym": "lets favors pile up unpaid", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "trades friendship for advantage", "gloss": "This means cultivating and dropping friends according to what they can offer in status, money or access.", "antonym": "keeps friends regardless of usefulness", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "stands by friends in disgrace", "gloss": "This means staying openly loyal to a friend through scandal, failure or public blame, even when others pull away.", "antonym": "distances self from disgraced friends", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "keeps friend groups separate", "gloss": "This means keeping each friend in an isolated circle so that the people one knows rarely meet or learn of one another.", "antonym": "mixes friends into one circle", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "downplays friends' successes", "gloss": "This means responding to a friend's good news with minimizing remarks, so the friend's achievement seems smaller than it is.", "antonym": "celebrates friends' successes openly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "tests friends with provocations", "gloss": "This means deliberately stirring small conflicts or offering slights to see whether a friend will stay loyal under strain.", "antonym": "takes friends' loyalty on trust", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "keeps the peace at any cost", "gloss": "This means avoiding disagreement with friends by yielding, agreeing or hiding objections, even when honesty is needed.", "antonym": "pushes back against friends", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
{"label": "forgives friends' lapses quickly", "gloss": "This means letting go of a friend's hurtful act soon after it happens, treating the friendship as more important than the offense.", "antonym": "holds friends' lapses against them", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4}
]}

Domain: friendship. Mode: a cognitive habit.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to friendship, each in the form of a cognitive habit (a way the person thinks, as opposed to an attitude they hold, something they do as a rule, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read the constraint as a habit of thought about friendship itself: how a person models, tallies, or interprets their ties, rather than what they do or feel. I chose mental patterns that people often apply without noticing, both admirable and unadmirable.",
"items": [
{"label": "tallies favors owed", "gloss": "This means keeping a running mental account of who has done what for whom, and expecting the balance to be settled.", "antonym": "lets favors pass unrecorded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
{"label": "charitable reading of slights", "gloss": "This means interpreting a friend's careless or hurtful act as unintended, and looking for the innocent explanation first.", "antonym": "reads slights as intent", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
{"label": "dwells on lapses", "gloss": "This means returning in thought to a friend's past failures and letting them define how the person is judged now.", "antonym": "sees the whole person", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "anticipates being dropped", "gloss": "This means expecting that close ties will end, and reading ordinary distance as the first sign of a coming break.", "antonym": "assumes ties will hold", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
{"label": "values ties by usefulness", "gloss": "This means judging how much a friendship is worth by what the other person can provide, such as help, contacts, or status.", "antonym": "values ties for themselves", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "sees potential bonds everywhere", "gloss": "This means treating new acquaintances as likely future intimates and quickly imagining closeness where little exists yet.", "antonym": "reserves closeness for few", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "idealizes past bonds", "gloss": "This means remembering old friendships as warmer and more faithful than they were, and comparing present ties unfavorably to them.", "antonym": "judges past bonds plainly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "reads dissent as disloyalty", "gloss": "This means taking a friend's disagreement as evidence of waning loyalty rather than as an ordinary difference of view.", "antonym": "treats dissent as normal", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "equates closeness with contact", "gloss": "This means assuming a bond is weak whenever the two people have not been in frequent touch, regardless of how they feel about each other.", "antonym": "separates closeness from contact", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "keeps circles separate", "gloss": "This means thinking of one's friend groups as sealed compartments, and reasoning as if mixing them would cause trouble.", "antonym": "lets circles mix", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "treats bonds as exchange", "gloss": "This means regarding a friendship as a fair trade of effort and benefit, and assessing it as one would a business arrangement.", "antonym": "treats bonds as unconditional", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
{"label": "forgives before offense", "gloss": "This means having already decided to excuse a friend's future wrongs, so that new hurts are absorbed without being examined.", "antonym": "holds grudges in reserve", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "imagines being judged", "gloss": "This means assuming friends are privately evaluating and criticizing one, and interpreting neutral reactions as hidden disapproval.", "antonym": "assumes goodwill", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "keeps backup companions", "gloss": "This means quietly maintaining several other close ties in case a current friendship fails, rather than investing fully in one.", "antonym": "commits to one circle", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "treats others as projects", "gloss": "This means viewing friends as people to improve or fix, and seeing the relationship mainly as a means of shaping them.", "antonym": "accepts others as they are", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "anticipates unspoken needs", "gloss": "This means assuming one knows what a friend wants or lacks without asking, and acting on those guesses as settled facts.", "antonym": "waits to be asked", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "gauges trust by disclosure", "gloss": "This means deciding how far to trust someone according to how much private information they have shared, treating openness as proof of loyalty.", "antonym": "trusts without evidence", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08}
]}

text:
{"approach": "I read 'social strategy' as a stable, deliberate way of managing friendships, such as keeping accounts, testing loyalty, or deciding how widely to share closeness. I included both admirable and unadmirable strategies, some without a single common word.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "keeps a favour ledger", "gloss": "This means tracking who owes whom and calling in debts, so that goodwill is treated as a balance to keep even.", "antonym": "gives without tallying", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},

  {"label": "tests loyalty with provocation", "gloss": "This means deliberately offending or baiting others in small ways to see whether they stay committed.", "antonym": "extends trust without testing", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
  {"label": "matches disclosures reciprocally", "gloss": "This means revealing a private thing only after the other person has revealed one of similar weight, so closeness rises in step.", "antonym": "holds back until trust is earned", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "lets ties lapse silently", "gloss": "This means letting relationships fade without explanation or farewell, simply ceasing contact when interest runs out.", "antonym": "keeps ties warm", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "collects contacts for advantage", "gloss": "This means cultivating people mainly for what they can offer one's position, career or status, and treating the connection as an asset.", "antonym": "keeps contacts for their own sake", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
  {"label": "keeps an open house", "gloss": "This means habitually inviting others into one's home and routines, so that people drop in and stay close without much planning.", "antonym": "keeps visitors at a distance", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "introduces people across circles", "gloss": "This means deliberately linking friends from separate groups who would not otherwise meet, and so widening everyone's social world.", "antonym": "keeps circles separate", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "reaches out first", "gloss": "This means making contact unprompted as a matter of habit, rather than waiting to be called or invited.", "antonym": "waits to be contacted", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
  {"label": "guards private time", "gloss": "This means protecting one's solitude and personal hours firmly, declining requests for time that others would like to have.", "antonym": "shares time freely", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
  {"label": "absorbs slights silently", "gloss": "This means letting small hurts pass without mention, so that minor offences are never raised or discussed with the person responsible.", "antonym": "voices small slights promptly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "courts people with flattery", "gloss": "This means winning others' affection by praising them lavishly and often, whether or not the praise is fully earned.", "antonym": "praises only what is earned", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
  {"label": "trades gossip for loyalty", "gloss": "This means sharing information about absent people to create intimacy and a sense of being trusted with secrets.", "antonym": "refuses to repeat gossip", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
  {"label": "holds others to promises", "gloss": "This means expecting friends to keep their word and calling them to account when they fail to follow through.", "antonym": "lets promises slide", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
  {"label": "adopts others' enthusiasms", "gloss": "This means taking up the hobbies and interests of companions in order to join them and keep them close.", "antonym": "keeps own interests separate", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
  {"label": "keeps one confidant only", "gloss": "This means limiting deep intimacy to a single person and keeping everyone else at a friendly but shallow level.", "antonym": "spreads closeness widely", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
  {"label": "makes amends first", "gloss": "This means apologising or repairing a rift without waiting for the other person to acknowledge fault.", "antonym": "waits to be apologised to", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
  {"label": "rarely asks for help", "gloss": "This means preferring to manage alone rather than request favours from others, so that friends seldom feel called upon.", "antonym": "asks for help readily", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45}
 ]}

{"label": "waldeinsamkeitssuchend", "romanization": "waldeinsamkeitssuchend", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "Das heißt: Sie zieht sich gern allein in den stillen Wald zurück und findet dort Ruhe und innere Sammlung.", "antonym": "geselligkeitssuchend", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "fernwehgeplagt", "romanization": "fernwehgeplagt", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "Das heißt: Er sehnt sich dauerhaft nach fernen Landschaften und Weiten und hält es ungern lange am selben Ort aus.", "antonym": "heimatverwurzelt", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "frischluftfanatisch", "romanization": "frischluftfanatisch", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "Das heißt: Sie besteht auf offenen Fenstern und Aufenthalt im Freien, bei fast jedem Wetter, und hält das für unverzichtbar gesund.", "antonym": "stubenhockerisch", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "stubenhockerisch", "romanization": "stubenhockerisch", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "Das heißt: Er bleibt am liebsten drinnen, meidet Ausflüge und Draußensein und findet Gemütlichkeit im Zimmer besser als jede Landschaft.", "antonym": "frischluftfanatisch", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "schönwettertyp", "romanization": "schönwettertyp", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "Das heißt: Sie geht nur bei Sonne und angenehmen Temperaturen nach draußen und sagt bei Regen oder Kälte alle Pläne ab.", "antonym": "wetterhart", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

{"label": "tierverliebt", "romanization": "tierverliebt", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "Das heißt: Sie gerät bei jedem Tier ins Schwärmen, spricht liebevoll mit ihm und stellt dessen Bedürfnisse oft über eigene.", "antonym": "tierabweisend", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

{"label": "naturentfremdet", "romanization": "naturentfremdet", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "Das heißt: Er kennt weder Pflanzen noch Tiere noch Jahreszeiten aus eigener Erfahrung und fühlt sich im Freien fremd und unsicher.", "antonym": "naturverbunden", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

{"label": "事なかれ主義", "romanization": "kotonakare shugi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは、問題が起きても深入りせず、何も起きなかったことにして穏便に済ませようとする傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは、問題を見つけたら放置せず、波が立っても取り上げて解決しようとする傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "根に持つ", "romanization": "ne ni motsu", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは、過去の揉め事や不快な出来事を長く覚えていて、何年たっても心のどこかで恨み続ける傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは、いさかいがあっても長く引きずらず、早く気持ちを切り替える傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

{"label": "負けず嫌い", "romanization": "makezu girai", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは、議論でも張り合いでも相手に負けることを嫌い、引き下がらずに言い返したり食い下がったりする傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは、勝ち負けにこだわらず、相手に譲ることをあまり悔しく感じない傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "喧嘩腰", "romanization": "kenka goshi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは、些細な意見の違いにも最初から攻撃的な口調や態度で応じ、衝突を招きやすい傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは、意見が食い違っても穏やかな口調と態度を保ち、衝突を招かないようにする傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

{"label": "腹芸", "romanization": "haragei", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは、言葉にせず表情や間合いで本心や意図を察し合い、対立を表に出さずに話をまとめようとする傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは、意図や不満をすべて言葉にして明示し、察してもらうことに頼らない傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},

{"label": "泣き寝入り", "romanization": "nakineiri", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは、不当な扱いを受けても抗議や反論をせず、不満を飲み込んで黙って我慢してしまう傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは、不当な扱いを受けたら黙らずに、きちんと抗議して正当な扱いを求める傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

{"label": "長いものに巻かれる", "romanization": "nagai mono ni makareru", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは、対立が起きたとき、自分の意見よりも力のある側に従って波風を避けようとする傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは、力のある側に逆らうことになっても、自分の考えを曲げずに主張を通す傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

text:
{"approach": "身体との付き合い方を、健康管理、我慢と無理、休息と生活リズム、清潔や入浴、食、鍛錬への信念という面から読み解いた。日本語に特有の養生、やせ我慢、根性論、冷えへの警戒のような身体観も含めた。", "items": [
{"label": "健康オタク", "romanization": "kenkō otaku", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは健康情報や健康法に強い関心を持ち、食事や運動や睡眠を細かく調べて日々の生活に取り入れ続ける傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは健康に無関心で、体のことを調べも気にもせず暮らす傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "養生好き", "romanization": "yōjō zuki", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは病気になる前から、休息や滋養や体を冷やさない工夫など、穏やかな日々の手入れで体をいたわろうとする傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは体の手入れを後回しにし、不調が出るまで何もしない傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "無理をしがち", "romanization": "muri o shigachi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは疲れや痛みがあっても予定や期待を優先し、体の限界を超えて動き続けてしまう傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは限界の手前で休み、体に負担をかけないよう予定を調整する傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "やせ我慢", "romanization": "yase gaman", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは寒さや痛みや空腹をつらくないふりでこらえ、弱みを見せまいと意地を張る傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これはつらさを素直に口にして、遠慮なく助けや休息を求める傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "病院嫌い", "romanization": "byōin girai", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは体の不調があっても受診を先延ばしにし、なるべく医者にかからず自力でやり過ごそうとする傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは小さな不調でもすぐ受診し、定期的に検査を受けて安心を得る傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "不摂生", "romanization": "fusessei", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは食事や睡眠や運動の習慣が乱れても気にせず、体への配慮を欠いた生活を続ける傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは規則正しい食事と睡眠と運動を保ち、体調を乱さないよう心がける傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "宵っ張り", "romanization": "yoibbari", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは夜遅くまで起きているのが習慣で、朝は苦手なまま夜に調子が上がる生活リズムを好む傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは夜は早めに休み、朝早く起きて活動することを好む傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "体育会系", "romanization": "taiikukai kei", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは大声や礼儀や上下関係を重んじ、体力や気合で物事に当たることをよしとする運動部的な気質を意味する。", "antonym": "これは体力や気合に頼らず、静かに理屈や工夫で物事に当たる気質を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
{"label": "根性論", "romanization": "konjō ron", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは疲れや痛みや不調も気持ちの強さで乗り越えられると考え、休養や科学的な配慮を軽んじる姿勢を意味する。", "antonym": "これは不調には休養や適切な対処で応じ、気合だけに頼らない姿勢を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "冷えを気にする", "romanization": "hie o ki ni suru", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは体が冷えることを健康の大敵とみなし、腹巻きや温かい飲み物や靴下などで常に温めようとする傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは体の冷えをあまり気にせず、薄着や冷たい飲み物も平気で過ごす傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "潔癖", "romanization": "keppeki", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは手や体や持ち物の汚れを極端に嫌い、清潔を保つために洗浄や除菌を繰り返す傾向を意味する。道徳的な潔白の意味ではない。", "antonym": "これは多少の汚れを気にせず、衛生にこだわらずおおらかに過ごす傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
{"label": "長風呂好き", "romanization": "nagaburo zuki", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは湯船にゆっくり長くつかり、入浴で疲れを取り気持ちを整える時間を何より大切にする傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは入浴を手短に済ませ、湯につかる時間を惜しむ傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "食いしん坊", "romanization": "kuishinbō", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは食べることが大好きで、おいしいものへの欲求が強く、食事に人一倍の喜びと関心を向ける傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは食に関心が薄く、空腹が満たされれば内容にこだわらない傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "体の声を聞く", "romanization": "karada no koe o kiku", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは疲れや空腹や違和感などの小さな信号に敏感に気づき、それに合わせて休んだり食べたり動いたりする傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは体の信号を無視して、予定や思い込みのまま動き続ける傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "体調に敏感", "romanization": "taichō ni binkan", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは少しのだるさや痛みにも気づいて、重い病気ではないかと気にかけやすく、不安になりがちな傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは多少の不調なら気にも留めず、体調の変化に鈍感なまま過ごす傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "ダイエット癖", "romanization": "daietto guse", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは体重や体型を常に気にして、食事制限や新しい減量法を繰り返し試さずにいられない傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは体重や体型にとらわれず、食事を気ままに楽しむ傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "筋肉信仰", "romanization": "kinniku shinkō", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは筋肉をつければ心も人生も良くなると信じ、筋力トレーニングを生活の中心に据えて勧める傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これは筋力や鍛錬に価値を置かず、体を鍛えることに関心を持たない傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "ごろ寝好き", "romanization": "gorone zuki", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "これは用がなければ畳やソファに寝転がって過ごし、体を動かさずだらりと休むことを心地よく感じる傾向を意味する。", "antonym": "これはじっとしていられず、常に何かして体を動かしていたがる傾向を意味する。", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false}
]}
