  {"label": "تهتّك", "romanization": "tahattuk", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني قلة الحياء وانعدام الستر، فيكشف المرء ما يُستر من أمره دون مبالاة بنظرة الناس وأعرافهم.", "antonym": "ستر", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "مجاهرة بالمعصية", "romanization": "mujāhara bil-maʿṣiya", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يعلن المرء فعله المحرّم ويتباهى به أمام الناس بدل أن يكتمه، فلا يبالي بالفضيحة.", "antonym": "ستر", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "ستر", "romanization": "sitr", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني تغطية عيوب النفس والآخرين وكتمان ما يُستحيا منه، فلا يُشهَر بالزلّات ولا يُتحدَّث بها.", "antonym": "تهتّك", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "وفاء للشريك", "romanization": "wafāʾ lil-sharīk", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني الثبات على العهد مع الزوج أو الحبيب، وصون العلاقة من الخيانة والميل إلى الغير.", "antonym": "خيانة للشريك", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "خيانة للشريك", "romanization": "khiyānat lil-sharīk", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني ميل المرء إلى نقض عهد الزوجية أو الحب والمخادعة في العلاقة الحميمة، بصورة متكررة لا عرضية.", "antonym": "وفاء للشريك", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "غيرة", "romanization": "ghayra", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني الأنفة على العِرض والحرص على أن لا يُنتهك حق الأهل والشريك، فيأبى المرء أن يُشرك فيه غيره.", "antonym": "دياثة", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
  {"label": "دياثة", "romanization": "diyātha", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني قبول المرء بانتهاك عرض أهله أو زوجه وعدم الأنفة منه، بل قد يتغاضى عنه أو يرضى به.", "antonym": "غيرة", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "شهوانية", "romanization": "shahwāniyya", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن تكون الشهوة الجسدية أغلب دوافع المرء وأكثر ما يشغل تفكيره، فيقدّمها على سائر الاعتبارات.", "antonym": "زهد في الشهوات", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "تبذّل", "romanization": "tabadhdhul", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني الابتذال في الهيئة والكلام والعلاقات، وترك الوقار في ما يُصان عادةً، حتى يفقد المرء قيمة نفسه في أعين الناس.", "antonym": "تصوّن", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "كتمان السرّ", "romanization": "kitmān al-sirr", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني حفظ ما يُئتمن عليه المرء من أحوال الحميمية والعلاقات الخاصة، وعدم إفشائها لأحد مهما كانت الدوافع.", "antonym": "إفشاء السرّ", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "مراعاة الشريك", "romanization": "murāʿāt al-sharīk", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني الرفق بالشريك في العلاقة الحميمة، وتقديم رغبته وراحته، والحرص على ألا يتأذى أو يُهان.", "antonym": "أنانية في الفراش", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "أنانية في الفراش", "romanization": "anāniyyat fil-firāsh", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يهتم المرء بلذته وحاجته وحدهما في العلاقة الحميمة، فلا يبالي بمشاعر شريكه أو رضاه.", "antonym": "مراعاة الشريك", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "ريبة", "romanization": "rība", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني كثرة الشك في سلوك الشريك وأمانته دون دليل، فيتعامل معه بالتحفّظ والتتبّع الدائم.", "antonym": "ثقة بالشريك", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "صون العِرض", "romanization": "ṣawn al-ʿirḍ", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني الحرص على سمعة المرء وسمعة أهله في ما يتعلق بالعفاف والعلاقات، وحمايتها من الخوض والتجريح.", "antonym": "تفريط في العِرض", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true}
 ]}

user:
مجال الحياة: الجنس.
اذكر من 15 إلى 20 سمة خلقية تتعلق تحديدًا بكيفية تعامل المرء مع هذا المجال من الحياة: محمودة ومذمومة، مع تفضيل ما لا توجد له في الإنجليزية كلمة واحدة.
text:
{"approach": "عاملتُ «الجنس» مجالًا للسلوك في الحياء والحشمة والصون والوفاء والكتمان والعلاقة مع الشريك، لا مجالًا للوظائف أو الأفعال المفردة أو الرغبات العابرة. وأدرجتُ الفضائل والرذائل معًا، مع تفضيل مفاهيم تسميها العربية بدقة مثل الغيرة والصون والستر والمروءة.",
"items": [
{"label": "الحياء", "romanization": "al-hayaa'", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يتجنب المرء الكلام أو التصرف الفاحش في أمور الحميمية، ويستحي أن يُعرّض نفسه أو غيره لما يُخدش الحشمة.", "antonym": "الوقاحة", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
{"label": "العفّة", "romanization": "al-'iffa", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يضبط المرء شهوته ويمسك نفسه عن الانحراف، فلا يطلب ما لا يحل له ولا يستجيب لإغراء يخل بكرامته.", "antonym": "الفجور", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "الغيرة", "romanization": "al-ghayra", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يحمي المرء عرض أهله وحرمهم بحزم، فيأنف أن يُدنَّس شرفه أو يُنتهك ما يخصه، ويتحرك لصونه.", "antonym": "الدياثة", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
{"label": "المجون", "romanization": "al-majun", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني الاستهانة بالحدود الأخلاقية في العلاقات الجنسية، والتباهي بالتحلل منها، وعدم الاكتراث بما يمسّ الحشمة أو العرف.", "antonym": "الوقار", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "الصون", "romanization": "al-sawn", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يحفظ المرء كرامته وكرامة من يتصل بهم في الأمور الحميمة، فلا يبتذل نفسه ولا يُسقط غيره في مواقف تُهينه.", "antonym": "التبذّل", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "الوفاء الزوجي", "romanization": "al-wafa' al-zawji", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يبقى المرء مخلصًا لشريكه في العلاقة الزوجية، فلا يتجاوزه إلى غيره، ويحفظ العهد في السرّ والعلن.", "antonym": "الخيانة الزوجية", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "التحفّظ", "romanization": "al-tahaffuz", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يلتزم المرء الاعتدال والستر في التعبير عن مشاعره الحميمة، فلا يفصح عنها أمام الغرباء ولا يتجاوز ما يليق.", "antonym": "الجرأة المبتذلة", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "الستر", "romanization": "al-satr", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يكتم المرء عيوب غيره وأسرارهم الشخصية، ولا يتحدث بها ولا يكشفها، بل يُغطيها ما استطاع.", "antonym": "التشهير", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "الكبت", "romanization": "al-kabt", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يحجب المرء رغباته الحميمة عن نفسه وعن الآخرين حجبًا متكلفًا، فيُنكرها ويُعاقب نفسه عليها ويتوتر من ذكرها.", "antonym": "الانفلات", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "الشهوانية", "romanization": "al-shahwaniyya", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يغلب على المرء طلب اللذة الحسية والإشباع الجسدي، فيجعله محور اهتمامه وقراراته، ويطغى على ضبط النفس.", "antonym": "الزهد", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "التلاعب العاطفي", "romanization": "al-talaa'ub al-'atifi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يستعمل المرء المشاعر الحميمة وسيلةً لكسب سيطرة على شريكه، بالوعد والتهديد والإيهام، لتحقيق ما يريد.", "antonym": "الصدق العاطفي", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "الأنانية الحميمية", "romanization": "al-anaaniyya al-hamimiyya", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يسعى المرء إلى إشباع نفسه في العلاقة الحميمة دون اكتراث بحاجة شريكه ورغبته، فلا يرى إلا ما يريحه هو.", "antonym": "الإيثار الحميمي", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "البرود العاطفي", "romanization": "al-burud al-'atifi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يبقى المرء بعيدًا عن الدفء والتفاعل في العلاقة الحميمة، فلا يظهر اهتمامًا أو تعاطفًا مع من يشاركه إياها.", "antonym": "الدفء العاطفي", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "الرفق بالشريك", "romanization": "al-rifq bil-shareek", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يعامل المرء شريكه بلطف ولين في الحميمية، فيراعي خوفه وتعبه ورغبته، ولا يُؤذيه بقسوة أو عجلة.", "antonym": "القسوة على الشريك", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "الاستهتار", "romanization": "al-istihtar", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يتصرف المرء في أمور الحميمية دون تفكير في العواقب على نفسه أو على غيره، فلا يحتاط ولا يحسب الأضرار.", "antonym": "الحذر", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "المروءة", "romanization": "al-muru'a", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني أن يحفظ المرء النبل في علاقته بالجنس الآخر، فيصون الضعيف ولا يغدر ولا يُهين من ارتبط به، ويلتزم بما يليق بالرجال.", "antonym": "الخسّة", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false}
]}

text:
{"approach": "فهمتُ المجال على أنه الطريقة التي يستعمل بها المرء لسانه وكلامه وكتابته في تعامله مع الناس، فاخترتُ سمات تصف الأسلوب الثابت في الكلام، محمودةً ومذمومة، مع تفضيل ألفاظ عربية لا تقابلها كلمة إنجليزية واحدة.",
"items": [
{"label": "بليغ", "romanization": "baligh", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يُحسن اختيار الألفاظ وترتيبها، فيبلغ بكلامه قصده ويؤثر في سامعيه بسلاسة وإقناع.", "antonym": "عيي", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "عيي", "romanization": "ayyiy", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يتعثر في الكلام ويعجز عن التعبير عمّا في نفسه، فيتلكأ ويتردد حين يتكلم.", "antonym": "بليغ", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
{"label": "مهذار", "romanization": "mihdhar", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يكثر الكلام دون حاجة أو فائدة، ويتحدث في كل موضوع ولا يترك لغيره فرصة.", "antonym": "صموت", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "صموت", "romanization": "samoot", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يقلّ كلامه ويمسك لسانه، فلا يتكلم إلا قليلًا أو عند الضرورة.", "antonym": "مهذار", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "معسول اللسان", "romanization": "ma'sool al-lisan", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يزيّن كلامه بالمديح والعبارات الحلوة، يقصد بها استمالة الناس أو كسب ودّهم، وربما خداعهم.", "antonym": "فظّ اللسان", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "ذرب اللسان", "romanization": "dharib al-lisan", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يتكلم بحدّة وجرأة، فيجرح بكلامه ويقطع خصمه بعبارات لاذعة لا يحسب لها حسابًا.", "antonym": null, "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "صريح", "romanization": "sareeh", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يقول ما يعتقده بوضوح ودون مواربة، ولا يُخفي رأيه خوفًا أو مجاملةً.", "antonym": "معرّض", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "معرّض", "romanization": "mu'arridh", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يلمّح بكلامه دون أن يصرّح، فيقصد الشيء بالإشارة والتلميح بدلًا من ذكره مباشرةً.", "antonym": "صريح", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
{"label": "فظّ اللسان", "romanization": "fazz al-lisan", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يخاطب الناس بخشونة وغلظة، فيجرح مشاعرهم بعبارات جافة لا لين فيها.", "antonym": "معسول اللسان", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "متفيهق", "romanization": "mutafayhiq", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يتكلم بتكلّف وتعالم، فيتوسع في الكلام ويتصنع الفصاحة والعبارات المعقدة ليُظهر علمه.", "antonym": null, "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "متشدّق", "romanization": "mutashaddiq", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يتكلم متكلفًا، فيبالغ في تحسين مخارج حروفه ونبرته ليُري الناس فصاحته وتميّزه.", "antonym": null, "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
{"label": "مطنب", "romanization": "mutnib", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يُطيل الكلام ويكرره، ويتوسع في شرح ما لا يحتاج إلى شرح، فيُثقل على سامعه.", "antonym": "موجز", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "موجز", "romanization": "mujiz", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يختصر كلامه ويقصد المعنى بأقل الألفاظ، فلا يزيد ولا يطيل إلا بقدر الحاجة.", "antonym": "مطنب", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "بوّاح", "romanization": "bawwah", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من لا يكتم الأخبار ولا الأسرار، فيبوح بما يعرفه لكل من يسأل أو يصادف دون تحفّظ.", "antonym": "كتوم", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "كتوم", "romanization": "katoom", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يحفظ الأسرار ولا يبوح بما اؤتمن عليه، ولا يكشف ما يعرفه إلا لمن يستحقه.", "antonym": "بوّاح", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "نمّام", "romanization": "nammam", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من ينقل كلام الناس بعضهم إلى بعض على وجه الإفساد والوقيعة بينهم، عادةً وطبعًا.", "antonym": null, "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "عفيف اللسان", "romanization": "afeef al-lisan", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يصون لسانه عن السبّ والبذاءة والكذب والغيبة، فلا يتكلم إلا بالطيّب من القول.", "antonym": "فحّاش", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "فحّاش", "romanization": "fahhash", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يكثر السبّ والشتم وألفاظ البذاءة، ولا يتحرّج من الكلام الفاحش في أي موقف.", "antonym": "عفيف اللسان", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
{"label": "لبِق", "romanization": "labiq", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "يعني من يقول الكلمة المناسبة في الوقت المناسب، فيحسن مخاطبة الناس ويتصرف بذكاء في الحديث.", "antonym": null, "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false}
]}

اذكر من 15 إلى 20 سمة خلقية تتعلق تحديدًا بكيفية تعامل المرء مع هذا المجال من الحياة: محمودة ومذمومة، مع تفضيل ما لا توجد له في الإنجليزية كلمة واحدة.
text:
{"approach": "أعامل اللغة بوصفها مجالًا تظهر فيه طبائع الكلام الثابتة: الميل إلى المزاح أو الثقل، والإيجاز أو الإسهاب، والصدق في القول أو المداراة فيه، وحسن الكلام أو قبحه. وأستبعد المهارة والفعل المفرد والدور، وأختار ما تعبّر عنه العربية بعبارة أو مصطلح أدق من الكلمة الإنجليزية المقابلة.",
"items": [

user:
حوزهٔ زندگی: دین.
۱۵ تا ۲۰ ویژگی منشی را نام ببرید که به‌طور مشخص به شیوهٔ رابطهٔ آدم با این حوزهٔ زندگی مربوط‌اند: هم ستودنی و هم ناستودنی، و آن‌هایی را ترجیح دهید که انگلیسی یک واژهٔ یگانه برایشان ندارد.
text:
{"approach": "حوزهٔ دین را به‌عنوان شیوهٔ آدم در باور، عمل، پرسش‌گری و نگاه به معنا و آخرت در نظر گرفته‌ام، نه خود ایمان یا وابستگی به یک آیین. ویژگی‌هایی را آوردم که در گفت‌وگوی فارسی‌زبانان دربارهٔ دینداری و تفاوت آدم‌ها دیده می‌شود، و برخی از آن‌ها عیب‌اند.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "خداترس", "romanization": "khodā-tars", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی از داوری و خشم خدا می‌ترسد و همین ترس رفتار روزمره‌اش را شکل می‌دهد.", "antonym": "بی‌باک", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "زاهد", "romanization": "zāhed", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی عمداً از لذت‌های دنیا دوری می‌کند و ساده و کم‌توقع زندگی می‌کند.", "antonym": "دنیاطلب", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "مقدس‌مآب", "romanization": "moqaddas-māb", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی ظاهری پرهیزگارانه دارد و آن را برای دیده‌شدن و کسب جایگاه به کار می‌گیرد، نه از سر باور.", "antonym": "یک‌رنگ", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "متعصب", "romanization": "mota'asseb", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی باور خودش را تنها راه درست می‌داند و در برابر دیدگاه‌های دیگر بسته و سرسخت است.", "antonym": "مدارا‌گر", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "مدارا‌گر", "romanization": "modārā-gar", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی به باورهای دیگران احترام می‌گذارد و حتی وقتی با آن‌ها موافق نیست، آن‌ها را تحمل می‌کند.", "antonym": "متعصب", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "تکفیرگرا", "romanization": "takfir-garā", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی دیگران را به‌سادگی کافر یا گمراه می‌خواند و از این حکم شتاب‌زده نوعی برتری احساس می‌کند.", "antonym": "آسان‌گیر", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "خرافه‌پذیر", "romanization": "khorāfe-pazir", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی به فال، نشانه‌ها و باورهای بی‌پایه دربارهٔ سرنوشت دل می‌بندد و به آن‌ها اعتماد می‌کند.", "antonym": "عقل‌گرا", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "عقل‌گرا", "romanization": "aql-garā", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی باورهای دینی را با سنجش و استدلال می‌سنجد و به چیزی که نمی‌تواند توضیح دهد تن نمی‌دهد.", "antonym": "خرافه‌پذیر", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "پرسش‌گر", "romanization": "porseš-gar", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی آموزه‌های دینی را بی‌چون‌وچرا نمی‌پذیرد و دربارهٔ معنا و دلیل آن‌ها پرسش می‌کند.", "antonym": "تسلیم", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "تسلیم", "romanization": "taslīm", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی خود را در برابر خواست خدا می‌سپارد و در برابر آنچه پیش می‌آید آرام و پذیرا می‌ماند.", "antonym": "پرسش‌گر", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},

  {"label": "ظاهرگرا", "romanization": "zāher-garā", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی دین را بیشتر در شکل‌ها و آیین‌های بیرونی می‌بیند تا در معنا و نیت درونی آن.", "antonym": "باطن‌گرا", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "باطن‌گرا", "romanization": "bāten-garā", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی به نیت، معنا و پاکی درونی بیش از شکل‌های بیرونی دین توجه دارد.", "antonym": "ظاهرگرا", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "آخرت‌اندیش", "romanization": "ākhirat-andīsh", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی بیشتر تصمیم‌هایش را با نگاه به زندگی پس از مرگ و پاداش و کیفر آن می‌گیرد.", "antonym": "دنیاگرا", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "تکلیف‌گرا", "romanization": "taklīf-garā", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی به انجام دقیق واجب‌های دینی پایبند است و آن‌ها را حتی وقتی سخت یا بی‌معناست رعایت می‌کند.", "antonym": "آسان‌گیر", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "تقیه‌ورز", "romanization": "taqiyye-varz", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی وقتی جان یا آسایشش در خطر است، باورهای خود را پنهان می‌کند و در ظاهر با جمع همراه می‌شود.", "antonym": "صریح‌گو", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "معنویت‌جو", "romanization": "ma'nawiyyat-jū", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "این یعنی بی‌آنکه به دین خاصی وابسته باشد، دنبال معنا و آرامش درونی در تجربه‌های روحانی می‌گردد.", "antonym": "مادی‌گرا", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false}
 ]}

  {"label": "말수", "romanization": "malsu", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 평소에 입을 여는 빈도와 분량이 많은지 적은지에 대한 전반적인 경향이다.", "antonym": "이는 꼭 필요한 말만 적게 하고 대화에서 말을 아끼며 듣는 쪽에 서는 경향이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

text:
{"approach": "자연을 대하는 태도, 즉 자연과 맺는 정서적 거리, 존중, 두려움, 이용 방식에서 오래 이어지는 기질을 찾았습니다. 계절이나 날씨에 대한 일시적 반응과 직업이나 지위는 제외했습니다.",
 "items": [

  {"label": "풍류", "romanization": "pungnyu", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자연 속에서 흥과 멋을 찾아 느긋하게 즐기고, 그 아름다움을 삶의 여유로 삼는 태도이다.", "antonym": "이는 자연의 아름다움에 무심하고 쓸모와 효율만 따지며 주변 경치를 지나치는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
  {"label": "호젓함 즐김", "romanization": "hojeotham jeulgim", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 사람 많은 곳을 피해 외지고 고요한 자연 속에서 혼자 있는 시간을 편안하게 누리는 성향이다.", "antonym": "이는 자연에서도 늘 사람들과 어울려야 마음이 놓이고, 적막하면 불안해지는 성향이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "절기 챙김", "romanization": "jeolgi chaenggim", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 계절이 바뀌는 절기를 기억하고 그때마다 먹거리나 생활 방식을 맞춰 챙기는 꼼꼼한 태도이다.", "antonym": "이는 계절이 바뀌어도 달력이나 절기에 신경 쓰지 않고 자기 방식대로만 살아가는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "날씨 타령", "romanization": "nalssi taryeong", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 날씨가 조금만 변해도 그 얘기를 길게 늘어놓고 기분과 하루 계획을 날씨에 맡기는 버릇이다.", "antonym": "이는 날씨가 어떻든 크게 개의치 않고 제 할 일과 마음가짐을 일정하게 지키는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "기미 읽기", "romanization": "gimi ilgi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 바람, 구름, 새의 움직임 같은 작은 신호를 살펴 앞으로 날씨나 자연의 변화를 미리 헤아리는 감각이다.", "antonym": "이는 주변 자연의 작은 변화를 알아차리지 못하고 눈앞에 드러난 것만 보는 둔한 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},

  {"label": "자연 순응", "romanization": "jayeon sun-eung", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자연의 흐름을 거스르지 않고 그 리듬에 몸과 생활을 맞추어 따라가는 태도이다.", "antonym": "이는 자연의 흐름과 한계를 무시하고 자신의 계획과 욕구를 밀어붙이는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

  {"label": "자연 앞 겸손", "romanization": "jayeon ap gyeomson", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 드넓은 산과 바다 앞에서 자신을 작게 여기며 자연의 크기를 존중하고 자기를 낮추는 태도이다.", "antonym": "이는 자연의 크기 앞에서도 자신을 내세우고 주눅 들지 않으며 과장되게 행동하는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

  {"label": "산수벽", "romanization": "sansubyeok", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 산과 물이 어우러진 경치를 지나치게 좋아해서 기회만 있으면 그곳을 찾아 떠나고 싶어 하는 성향이다.", "antonym": "이는 아름다운 경치에 특별한 관심을 두지 않고 집이나 일상에 머무는 것을 편하게 여기는 성향이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "텃밭 정", "romanization": "teotbat jeong", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 집 주변의 밭과 마당에 심은 식물에 애틋한 정을 붙이고 매일 돌보며 아끼는 마음이다.", "antonym": "이는 자신이 기르는 식물이나 가꾸는 땅에 별다른 애착을 느끼지 않고 쉽게 내버려 두는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

 ]}

사람이 이 삶의 영역과 맺는 관계 방식에 특히 관련된 성격 특성을 15개에서 20개 말해 주세요. 훌륭한 것도 그렇지 않은 것도 포함하고, 영어에 대응하는 단어가 하나도 없는 것을 우선하세요.
text:
{"approach": "아름다움을 대하는 태도, 곧 정취와 취향을 누리고 꾸밈과 안목으로 드러내거나 평가하는 방식에 초점을 맞췄습니다. 미모나 직업 같은 역할과 일시적 기분은 제외했습니다.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "멋", "romanization": "meot", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 겉모습과 몸가짐에서 자기만의 세련되고 흥취 있는 맵시를 자연스럽게 드러내는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 꾸밈이나 흥취에 무심해서 밋밋하고 무던한 태도를 고수하는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "풍류", "romanization": "pungnyu", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 음악, 글, 술, 자연처럼 아름다운 것을 여유롭게 즐기며 삶을 운치 있게 누리려는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 아름다움에서도 실용이나 성과만 찾고 여유를 두지 않으려는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "운치", "romanization": "unchi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 공간이나 순간에서 은근한 정취와 고즈넉한 분위기를 알아차리고 아끼는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 분위기나 정취에 둔감해서 오직 기능과 편의만 따지는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "안목", "romanization": "anmok", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 사물의 좋고 나쁨을 가려내는 눈이 높아서 쉽게 만족하지 않는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 좋고 나쁨을 가리는 기준 없이 무엇이든 쉽게 받아들이는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "고상떨기", "romanization": "gosangtteolgi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실제보다 우아하고 품위 있는 척하면서 격식과 취향을 은근히 과시하는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 꾸밈없이 자연스럽고 편안하게 자신을 드러내는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "촌티 기피", "romanization": "chontti gipi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 남 보기에 투박하거나 뒤떨어져 보일까 봐 유행과 세련됨에 지나치게 신경 쓰는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 남들 눈에 어떻게 보이든 개의치 않고 투박해도 제 방식을 지키는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},

  {"label": "여백 선호", "romanization": "yeobaek seonho", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 빈틈과 여유를 아름다움의 일부로 여겨서 공간이나 일정을 가득 채우기보다 비워 두기를 좋아하는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 빈틈을 불안하게 느껴서 공간과 일정을 빠짐없이 채우려는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "정갈함", "romanization": "jeonggalham", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 주변 물건과 자신의 차림을 흐트러짐 없이 말끔하고 단정하게 정돈하려는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 물건과 차림이 어수선해도 크게 개의치 않는 느슨한 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "아기자기함", "romanization": "agijagiham", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 작고 귀여운 것들을 모으고 꾸미며 사소한 아름다움에서 즐거움을 느끼는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 작은 장식이나 세부에 관심이 없고 크고 단순한 것을 선호하는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "명품병", "romanization": "myeongpumbyeong", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 물건 자체의 쓸모보다 비싸고 유명한 상표가 주는 과시적 만족을 더 중시하는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 상표보다 실제 쓰임과 자기 마음에 드는지를 기준으로 물건을 고르는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "탐미", "romanization": "tammi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 아름다운 것 앞에서 그 자체에 깊이 빠져들어 다른 것을 잊을 만큼 감각적 감동을 좇는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 아름다움보다 실용과 효율을 앞세워 감각적 즐거움을 가볍게 여기는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "취향 고집", "romanization": "chwihyang gojip", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자기 취향에 맞지 않으면 남의 권유나 유행을 받아들이지 않고 끝까지 자기 방식을 밀고 나가는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 남의 취향과 유행을 쉽게 받아들여 자기 미감을 자주 바꾸는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "외모 집착", "romanization": "oemo jipchak", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자기 외양이 남에게 어떻게 평가받을지 늘 신경 쓰며 겉모습을 가꾸는 데 지나치게 몰두하는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 외모에 관심을 두지 않고 내면이나 하는 일로 자신을 드러내려는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "겉치레", "romanization": "geotchire", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 속은 돌보지 않고 보이는 겉모양을 번듯하게 꾸미는 데 힘을 쏟는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 겉보다 속을 채우는 것을 먼저 생각하여 꾸밈에 무심한 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false}
 ]}

  {"label": "절제미", "romanization": "jeoljemi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 화려함을 덜어내고 적당한 선에서 멈춤으로써 생기는 아름다움을 높이 사는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 넘치도록 쌓아 올리고 채워야 만족하는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "겉치레", "romanization": "geotchille", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 속이 어떠하든 겉모습만 번듯하게 보이도록 공들이는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 겉보다 실속과 내용을 먼저 챙기는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "풍류", "romanization": "pungnyu", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 시, 음악, 자연의 운치를 여유 있게 즐기며 아름다움에서 흥취를 찾는 기질이다.", "antonym": null, "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "외모지상주의", "romanization": "oemojisangjuui", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 외모가 사람의 가치와 대우를 크게 좌우한다고 믿고 그 기준으로 사람을 평가하는 태도다.", "antonym": null, "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "외모 열등감", "romanization": "oemo yeoldeunggam", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자신의 외모가 남보다 못하다고 느끼고 그 생각에 자주 움츠러드는 마음이다.", "antonym": "이는 자신의 외모를 크게 의식하지 않고 편안하게 받아들이는 태도다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "자기도취", "romanization": "jagidochwi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자신의 외모나 모습에 지나치게 감탄하고 그것을 남들도 봐 주기를 바라는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 자신의 모습을 대수롭지 않게 여기며 다른 사람에게 주목을 구하지 않는 태도다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "허영", "romanization": "heoyeong", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실제보다 더 아름답고 돋보이고 싶어서 남에게 보이는 모습에 집착하는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 겉보기에 신경 쓰지 않고 실속과 검소함을 택하는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "호사 취향", "romanization": "hosa chwihyang", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 좋은 물건과 고급스러운 것을 가까이 두고 누리는 것을 즐기는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 소박하고 간소한 것에 만족하며 사치를 멀리하는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "단정함", "romanization": "danjeongham", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 옷차림과 행동을 흐트러짐 없이 깔끔하게 정리하고 그 모습을 지키려는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 옷차림과 주변 정돈에 크게 신경 쓰지 않고 헐렁하게 지내는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "미색에 약함", "romanization": "misaek-e yakham", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 아름다운 얼굴이나 모습에 쉽게 마음이 끌려 판단이 흐려지는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 외모에 끌리지 않고 상대의 내면이나 성격을 먼저 살피는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "가꿈", "romanization": "gakkum", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자기 몸과 모습을 꾸준하고 정성스럽게 돌보며 살피는 태도를 뜻한다.", "antonym": "이는 자기 몸과 외모를 돌보는 일을 소홀히 하고 무관심한 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false}
 ]}

user:
삶의 영역: 실수.
사람이 이 삶의 영역과 맺는 관계 방식에 특히 관련된 성격 특성을 15개에서 20개 말해 주세요. 훌륭한 것도 그렇지 않은 것도 포함하고, 영어에 대응하는 단어가 하나도 없는 것을 우선하세요.
text:
{"approach": "실수를 저지른 뒤 그것을 숨기거나, 인정하거나, 곱씹거나, 남에게 떠넘기는 방식에서 드러나는 지속적인 기질을 중심으로 골랐습니다. 체면, 눈치, 넉살처럼 한국어 화자가 실수 상황에서 자연스럽게 떠올리는 개념을 우선했습니다.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "쉬쉬하기", "romanization": "swiswihagi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 잘못이 드러나지 않도록 주변 사람들에게 조용히 입단속을 시키며 일을 덮어 두려는 방식이다.", "antonym": "이는 잘못을 숨기지 않고 있었던 그대로 주변에 털어놓는 방식이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "면피주의", "romanization": "myeonpijuui", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자신이 비난받지 않는 것을 최우선으로 두고, 책임이 돌아오지 않도록 처신하는 태도이다.", "antonym": "이는 비난을 감수하더라도 자기 몫의 책임을 먼저 짊어지려는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "오기", "romanization": "ogi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 틀렸다는 것이 드러났는데도 자존심 때문에 물러서지 않고 끝까지 고집을 부리는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 자신이 틀렸다는 것을 깨달으면 체면을 따지지 않고 바로 물러서는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "구차하게 둘러대기", "romanization": "guchahage dulleodaegi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수가 드러난 뒤에도 그럴듯한 핑계를 이것저것 늘어놓으며 어떻게든 자신을 변호하려는 습관이다.", "antonym": "이는 실수를 변명 없이 짧고 분명하게 인정하고 넘어가는 습관이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "곱씹기 성향", "romanization": "gopssipgi seonghyang", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 지나간 실수를 머릿속에서 자꾸 되풀이해 떠올리며 같은 장면을 반복해서 괴로워하는 성향이다.", "antonym": "이는 실수를 한번 돌아본 뒤 더 붙잡지 않고 다음 일로 마음을 옮기는 성향이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "습관적 사과", "romanization": "seupgwanjeok sagwa", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 잘못의 크기와 상관없이 별일 아닌 상황에서도 습관처럼 먼저 미안하다고 말하는 버릇이다.", "antonym": "이는 정말 잘못했을 때만 사과를 아끼고, 사과의 말에 무게를 싣는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "넉살", "romanization": "neoksal", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수를 하고도 당황하는 기색 없이 능청스럽고 태연하게 분위기를 넘겨 버리는 뻔뻔한 재주이다.", "antonym": "이는 작은 실수에도 얼굴이 굳고 분위기가 무거워져 어쩔 줄 모르는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
  {"label": "남 탓 돌리기", "romanization": "nam tat dolligi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자신의 잘못을 다른 사람, 환경, 상황의 탓으로 돌려서 자기 책임을 밀어내는 습관이다.", "antonym": "이는 일이 잘못되었을 때 먼저 자신에게서 원인을 찾아보는 습관이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "지나친 조심성", "romanization": "jinachin josimseong", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수할까 봐 매사에 지나치게 신경을 곤두세우고 움직임을 줄이며 위축되는 성향이다.", "antonym": "이는 실수 가능성을 어느 정도 받아들이고 가볍게 시도하며 배우는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "짐짓 태연하기", "romanization": "jimjit taeyeonhagi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 속으로는 크게 당황했으면서도 겉으로는 아무렇지 않은 척 표정과 말투를 꾸며 내는 태도이다.", "antonym": "이는 마음에 동요가 생기면 감정이 얼굴과 말에 그대로 드러나는 솔직한 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "면목 없어하기", "romanization": "myeonmok eopseohagi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수로 남들 앞에 설 얼굴이 없다고 느끼며 오래 움츠러들고 쉽게 고개를 들지 못하는 성향이다.", "antonym": "이는 실수 뒤에도 얼굴빛을 크게 바꾸지 않고 자연스럽게 다시 자리에 어울리는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "엄살 부리기", "romanization": "eomsal burigi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실제보다 과장해서 힘들고 아픈 척 호소하며 실수로 생긴 부담을 남의 동정으로 덜어 내려는 태도이다.", "antonym": "이는 실수로 생긴 어려움을 내색하지 않고 묵묵히 감당하는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
  {"label": "자기채찍질", "romanization": "jagi chaejjikjil", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수한 자신을 가혹하게 몰아세우며 벌을 주듯 스스로를 끊임없이 질책하는 가학적인 성향이다.", "antonym": "이는 실수를 인정하되 자신을 지나치게 탓하지 않고 다독이며 다시 나아가는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "눈치 보기", "romanization": "nunchi bogi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수 뒤에 주변 사람들의 표정과 반응을 민감하게 살피며 그들의 기분에 맞춰 자신을 조정하는 태도이다.", "antonym": "이는 주변의 반응과 상관없이 자신이 옳다고 여기는 방식으로 행동하는 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
  {"label": "체면 차리기", "romanization": "chemyeon charigi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수를 하고도 남에게 흠잡히지 않으려고 품위와 위신을 지키는 쪽으로 행동을 꾸미는 태도이다.", "antonym": "이는 체면보다 실제 잘못을 바로잡는 일을 앞세우는 실용적인 태도이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "얼버무리기", "romanization": "eolbeomurigi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수에 대해 분명한 설명을 피하고 모호한 말로 대충 넘기며 상대가 더 묻지 못하게 만드는 방식이다.", "antonym": "이는 실수의 경위와 내용을 빠짐없이 또렷하게 밝히는 방식이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false}
 ]}

text:
{"approach": "실수를 저지른 뒤 인정하고, 감추고, 수습하고, 다른 사람의 잘못을 대하는 방식에서 드러나는 지속적인 기질로 해석했습니다. 훌륭한 태도와 그렇지 않은 태도를 함께 담았습니다.",
 "items": [
  {"label": "염치", "romanization": "yeomchi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자기가 잘못했을 때 부끄러움을 알고 그 부끄러움을 체면보다 앞에 두는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 잘못을 해도 부끄러움을 느끼지 않고 뻔뻔하게 굴며 체면을 아끼지 않는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "낯 두꺼움", "romanization": "nat dukkeoum", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수를 지적받아도 얼굴이 붉어지거나 움츠러들지 않고 태연하게 버티는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 작은 실수에도 얼굴이 쉽게 달아오르고 남 앞에서 움츠러드는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "오기", "romanization": "ogi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 자기 잘못이 드러나도 지기 싫은 마음에 고집을 부리며 끝내 인정하지 않으려는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 틀렸다는 것을 알면 자존심을 접고 바로 고개를 숙이는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},
  {"label": "시치미", "romanization": "sichimi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 잘못을 저질러 놓고도 모르는 척 태연한 얼굴을 꾸미며 책임을 피하려는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 잘못이 드러나면 숨기지 않고 있는 그대로 털어놓는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "능청", "romanization": "neungcheong", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수를 들켜도 당황하지 않고 천연덕스럽고 익살스럽게 상황을 넘기는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 어색하고 서툰 태도로 감추려 해서 금세 들통나 버리는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "묵은 잘못 들추기", "romanization": "mugeun jalmot deulchugi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 이미 지나간 남의 실수를 기억해 두었다가 다툼이나 기회가 생길 때마다 다시 꺼내 말하는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 지나간 잘못은 묻어 두고 다시 거론하지 않는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "넉살", "romanization": "neoksal", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 실수를 만회하거나 분위기를 풀기 위해 뻔뻔해 보일 만큼 너스레를 떨며 웃어넘기는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 실수한 뒤 말문이 막히고 어쩔 줄 몰라 위축되는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false},
  {"label": "뭉개기", "romanization": "mungaegi", "english_hint": null, "gloss": "이는 잘못된 일을 바로잡지 않고 그대로 두거나 흐지부지 덮어 시간이 해결해 주기를 기다리는 기질이다.", "antonym": "이는 잘못을 발견하면 미루지 않고 곧바로 손을 대어 수습하는 기질이다.", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true},

user:
Domain: strangers. Mode: a social strategy.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to strangers, each in the form of a social strategy (a strategy the person uses with other people, as opposed to an attitude they hold, something they do as a rule, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, or a moral stance they take). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read 'social strategy' as a deliberate, repeated tactic someone uses on strangers to get something (safety, advantage, connection, status, or distance), not an attitude or a feeling. I mixed warm and cold tactics and favored descriptive phrases over common single words.", "items": [
{"label": "strikes up conversation", "gloss": "This means the person routinely opens talk with people they don't know, in queues or on trains, as a way to create connection.", "antonym": "keeps to themselves", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55},
{"label": "ingratiating", "gloss": "This means the person flatters and agrees with new acquaintances quickly to win their favor before they know them.", "antonym": "aloof", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "wary of newcomers", "gloss": "This means the person tests and observes unfamiliar people at length before offering any trust or information.", "antonym": "quick to trust", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "name-dropping", "gloss": "This means the person mentions impressive connections or achievements early with new people to raise their standing.", "antonym": "unpretentious", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "mirrors the other person", "gloss": "This means the person copies a stranger's tone, posture and interests to create a quick sense of rapport.", "antonym": "stays distinctly themselves", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "disarms with humor", "gloss": "This means the person uses a light joke or self-mockery with strangers to ease tension and seem harmless.", "antonym": "stiffly formal", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "oversharing early", "gloss": "This means the person reveals intimate details to people just met, hoping disclosure will force closeness.", "antonym": "guarded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "networking relentlessly", "gloss": "This means the person treats every new meeting as a chance to gather contacts that may be useful later.", "antonym": "uninterested in contacts", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "sizes people up", "gloss": "This means the person quickly assesses a stranger's status, usefulness and threat, and adjusts behavior to match.", "antonym": "takes people as they come", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "gives the benefit of the doubt", "gloss": "This means the person deliberately starts from good faith with unknown people and withdraws it only after clear evidence.", "antonym": "assumes the worst", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "preemptively cold", "gloss": "This means the person acts brusque and unfriendly toward newcomers first, to avoid being rejected or imposed upon.", "antonym": "preemptively warm", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "plays a persona", "gloss": "This means the person presents a curated, invented version of themselves to people who don't know them.", "antonym": "the same with everyone", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "fakes familiarity", "gloss": "This means the person acts as if they already know a stranger well, using first names and in-jokes to lower defenses.", "antonym": "formally polite", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "asks questions to deflect", "gloss": "This means the person turns the conversation to the stranger's life so they never have to reveal anything about themselves.", "antonym": "talks mostly about self", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "cultivates strangers as allies", "gloss": "This means the person deliberately does small favors for unfamiliar people to build a stock of goodwill for later.", "antonym": "owes no one anything", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.07},
{"label": "hides behind politeness", "gloss": "This means the person uses flawless courtesy toward strangers as a wall that keeps everyone at a pleasant distance.", "antonym": "openly familiar", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.07},
{"label": "befriends the gatekeeper", "gloss": "This means the person is warm and attentive to receptionists, doormen and similar newcomers to get access or goodwill.", "antonym": "ignores underlings", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.04},
{"label": "scripts small talk", "gloss": "This means the person prepares topics and stock lines ahead of meeting new people to avoid awkward silences.", "antonym": "improvises freely", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.05},
{"label": "anchors on shared ground", "gloss": "This means the person searches new acquaintances for common ties, such as hometowns or mutual friends, before talking about anything else.", "antonym": "dwells on differences", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.06},
{"label": "tests with a small ask", "gloss": "This means the person requests a minor favor from a stranger to gauge how helpful and trustworthy they are.", "antonym": "never asks for help", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.03}
]}

user:
Domain: money. Mode: an attitude.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to money, each in the form of an attitude (an attitude the person holds, as opposed to something they do as a rule, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read the constraint as dispositions where the person holds a stance toward money itself, such as what it is for, what it says about them, or how much it deserves. I kept to attitudes rather than habits or tactics, and I included less obvious ones that need a phrase rather than a single word.", "items": [
{"label": "frugal", "gloss": "This means they regard careful restraint in spending as sensible and see waste as something to avoid.", "antonym": "extravagant", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.85},
{"label": "materialistic", "gloss": "This means they believe that possessions and wealth are the main measure of a good life and of personal worth.", "antonym": "unmaterialistic", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
{"label": "generous with wealth", "gloss": "This means they see money as something to be shared freely and feel it is meant to benefit others as well as themselves.", "antonym": "tightfisted", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "money-shy", "gloss": "This means they feel that talking about or wanting money is faintly improper, and they treat it as something to be kept out of sight.", "antonym": "money-comfortable", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "scarcity-minded", "gloss": "This means they assume there will never be enough, so every sum looks like something that could run out and has to be guarded.", "antonym": "abundance-minded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "abundance-minded", "gloss": "This means they trust that money and opportunity are plentiful and will come again, so they hold their funds loosely.", "antonym": "scarcity-minded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "covetous", "gloss": "This means they look at what others own with a steady wish to have it, and they measure their own holdings against it.", "antonym": "content with enough", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "content with enough", "gloss": "This means they hold that a modest sufficiency is all they need and feel no pull to gather more than that.", "antonym": "insatiable", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "mercenary", "gloss": "This means they think of nearly every undertaking mainly as a source of payment and judge it by what it earns them.", "antonym": "disinterested", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "spendthrift", "gloss": "This means they see money as meant to be spent now and give little weight to what remains for later.", "antonym": "thrifty", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
{"label": "status-spending minded", "gloss": "This means they view money chiefly as a way to show their standing, and they value buying things that others will notice.", "antonym": "indifferent to appearances", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "money-as-security", "gloss": "This means they treat savings above all as a cushion against disaster and feel that more of it means more safety.", "antonym": "money-as-freedom", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "tightfisted", "gloss": "This means they hate to part with money and regard giving or paying out as a loss to be minimised.", "antonym": "open-handed", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "indifferent to wealth", "gloss": "This means they hold that riches carry little importance and show no wish to accumulate or display them.", "antonym": "avaricious", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "entitled to others' money", "gloss": "This means they take it for granted that other people ought to cover their costs, and they feel owed rather than grateful.", "antonym": "self-reliant", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "money-is-dirty", "gloss": "This means they believe wealth is tainted and that rich people must have compromised themselves to get it.", "antonym": "pro-wealth", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "avaricious", "gloss": "This means they have an intense, grasping hunger for more wealth that no amount seems to satisfy.", "antonym": "content with enough", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
{"label": "money-as-freedom", "gloss": "This means they value wealth mainly for the choices it opens and see it as a means to independence.", "antonym": "money-as-security", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.07},
{"label": "casual about debt", "gloss": "This means they regard owing money as unremarkable and feel little worry about what they owe or when it falls due.", "antonym": "debt-averse", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "debt-averse", "gloss": "This means they find owing anyone money deeply uncomfortable and consider being in debt a burden to be escaped.", "antonym": "casual about debt", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2}
]}

user:
Domain: money. Mode: a habit.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to money, each in the form of a habit (something the person does as a rule, as opposed to an attitude they hold, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read this as recurring money behaviors a person does as a rule, such as how they spend, save, track, share or hide money, and I leaned toward specific habits that lack a common single word, mixing admirable and unadmirable ones.", "items": [
{"label": "thrifty", "gloss": "This means they routinely spend little and avoid waste, choosing the cheaper option and making things last as a matter of course.", "antonym": "extravagant", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.9},
{"label": "impulse buying", "gloss": "This means they regularly purchase things on a sudden urge, without planning or weighing whether they need them.", "antonym": "plans purchases carefully", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.8},
{"label": "budgets meticulously", "gloss": "This means they routinely map out income and expenses in advance and stick to the numbers month after month.", "antonym": "spends without a plan", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.7},
{"label": "pays bills on time", "gloss": "This means they settle what they owe by the due date every time, without reminders or late fees.", "antonym": "pays late", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "chronically late paying", "gloss": "This means they habitually let debts and invoices slip past their deadlines and settle only when pressed.", "antonym": "pays bills on time", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "saves automatically", "gloss": "This means they set aside a fixed part of every payment before spending any, so saving happens without effort.", "antonym": "saves only what is left", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "hunts for bargains", "gloss": "This means they habitually look for sales, coupons and discounts, and rarely buy anything at full price.", "antonym": "pays full price without looking", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55},
{"label": "lets others pick up the tab", "gloss": "This means they regularly let friends or companions pay the bill and seldom reach for their own wallet.", "antonym": "pays their own way", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "insists on splitting to the cent", "gloss": "This means they always work out each person's exact share of a bill and ask everyone to pay precisely that amount.", "antonym": "rounds up and lets it go", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "tips lavishly", "gloss": "This means they routinely leave well above the usual gratuity, whatever the service or the size of the bill.", "antonym": "tips stingily", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "keeps every receipt", "gloss": "This means they hold onto proof of nearly every purchase and file it away in case it is needed later.", "antonym": "throws receipts away", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},

{"label": "vengeful over killings", "gloss": "This means insisting that a death must be answered with another, and judging forgiveness toward a killer as betrayal of the victim.", "antonym": "forgiving toward killers", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "martyr-minded", "gloss": "This means believing that dying for a cause is the highest moral act and that clinging to life is shameful by comparison.", "antonym": "survival-first", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "honors last wishes", "gloss": "This means feeling morally bound to carry out what a dead person asked for, even when it is inconvenient or the living disagree.", "antonym": "ignores last wishes", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "speaks no ill of the dead", "gloss": "This means holding that the dead must not be criticized or disparaged, whatever they did while alive.", "antonym": "unsparing about the dead", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "callous about others' deaths", "gloss": "This means treating strangers' deaths as morally unimportant, so that suffering and loss beyond one's own circle weigh nothing in one's judgments.", "antonym": "grieves for strangers", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "believes in posthumous justice", "gloss": "This means holding that the dead can still be wronged or vindicated, so that reputations and wishes deserve defense after death.", "antonym": "thinks the dead cannot be wronged", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.07},
{"label": "pacifist", "gloss": "This means refusing on principle to kill or to take part in killing, even in defense or in war.", "antonym": "militant", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "pro-death-penalty", "gloss": "This means holding that some crimes deserve execution and that the state is right to carry it out.", "antonym": "abolitionist", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "obligated to the unborn and the dead", "gloss": "This means feeling that the living owe a debt to ancestors and descendants, and acting as a steward between them.", "antonym": "present-focused", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.04},
{"label": "sees death as deserved", "gloss": "This means believing that certain people get what is coming to them when they die badly, and feeling no pity for them.", "antonym": "pities even the wicked", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.06},
{"label": "refuses to profit from death", "gloss": "This means holding that gaining money or advantage from someone's death or misfortune is tainted and should be declined.", "antonym": "opportunistic about death", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.05},
{"label": "duty-bound to be present at deathbeds", "gloss": "This means believing one must be there when a loved one is dying, and counting absence as a serious failure of loyalty.", "antonym": "avoids deathbeds", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.06}

user:
Domain: rules. Mode: a social strategy.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to rules, each in the form of a social strategy (a strategy the person uses with other people, as opposed to an attitude they hold, something they do as a rule, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, or a moral stance they take). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read this as dispositions in which a person deals with other people through rules: using them as leverage, shielding, bargaining chips or social currency. I included admirable and unadmirable strategies and favored phrases over stock words like 'rule-follower'.", "items": [
{"label": "hides behind the rulebook", "gloss": "This means pointing to official rules to avoid responsibility or refuse a request, so that the refusal seems impersonal.", "antonym": "takes personal responsibility", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.55},
{"label": "bends rules for friends", "gloss": "This means quietly relaxing requirements for people they like or owe, trading favors through selective leniency.", "antonym": "even-handed", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.5},
{"label": "rules-lawyering", "gloss": "This means winning arguments or advantages by exploiting the exact wording of rules against the people they were meant to guide.", "antonym": "good-faith", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
{"label": "polices others' compliance", "gloss": "This means watching and correcting other people's rule-breaking, often unasked, to gain standing or control in a group.", "antonym": "lets others be", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
{"label": "asks forgiveness not permission", "gloss": "This means acting first and apologizing afterward when challenged, counting on others to accept what is already done.", "antonym": "seeks approval first", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.4},
{"label": "negotiates exceptions", "gloss": "This means persuading authorities or peers to grant special treatment, using charm, argument or timing rather than defiance.", "antonym": "accepts the standard terms", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "leads by example", "gloss": "This means following the rules visibly and consistently so that others feel nudged to do the same without being told.", "antonym": "do-as-I-say", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "enforces selectively", "gloss": "This means applying rules harshly to disliked people and gently to favored ones, using enforcement as a tool of preference.", "antonym": "applies rules uniformly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "explains the reasons behind rules", "gloss": "This means giving people the purpose of a rule so they will comply willingly and can judge hard cases themselves.", "antonym": "dictates without explanation", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "cites precedent", "gloss": "This means defending a request or refusal by pointing to how similar cases were handled before, so that it looks fair.", "antonym": "decides case by case", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "pulls rank", "gloss": "This means invoking their position of authority to override rules or objections instead of persuading people.", "antonym": "defers to the process", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "quietly works around", "gloss": "This means avoiding open conflict by finding unofficial routes around rules while keeping up a show of compliance.", "antonym": "openly objects", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "weaponizes procedure", "gloss": "This means using paperwork, deadlines and formal steps to delay, wear down or block opponents.", "antonym": "streamlines for others", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "keeps score of violations", "gloss": "This means remembering other people's past rule-breaking and bringing it up later as leverage in disputes.", "antonym": "lets old breaches go", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "shields subordinates from rules", "gloss": "This means absorbing the pressure of pointless regulations so the people under them can work without being burdened.", "antonym": "passes pressure downward", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "signals virtue by compliance", "gloss": "This means being conspicuously rule-abiding to win admiration and to quietly shame less careful people nearby.", "antonym": "complies without display", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "recruits accomplices", "gloss": "This means drawing others into a rule violation so that blame is shared and nobody is likely to report it.", "antonym": "takes the risk alone", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "proposes rules to bind rivals", "gloss": "This means pushing for new regulations that mostly constrain competitors while leaving their own habits untouched.", "antonym": "welcomes equal constraints", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.05},
{"label": "mediates by the letter and spirit", "gloss": "This means settling disputes by weighing what a rule says and what it was for, so both sides accept the outcome.", "antonym": "sides with one reading", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.06},
{"label": "plays dumb about rules", "gloss": "This means pretending not to know a rule existed so that a breach is excused as an honest mistake.", "antonym": "owns the breach", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15}
]}

user:
Domain: the body. Mode: a cognitive habit.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to the body, each in the form of a cognitive habit (a way the person thinks, as opposed to an attitude they hold, something they do as a rule, a way they speak, a feeling they tend to have, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read this as habits of thought about one's own body, such as how a person interprets, monitors, predicts or narrates bodily sensations and appearance. I leaned toward less common phrases and kept both healthy and unhealthy patterns.", "items": [
{"label": "hypochondriacal", "gloss": "This means reading ordinary aches and sensations as signs of serious illness and mentally building worst-case diagnoses from them.", "antonym": "unworried about symptoms", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.85},
{"label": "body-scanning", "gloss": "This means habitually running attention through the body, checking tension, pain and sensation, often without any particular reason to do so.", "antonym": "body-oblivious", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "body-oblivious", "gloss": "This means rarely noticing hunger, fatigue or pain in thought until they become impossible to ignore.", "antonym": "body-scanning", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "interoceptively attuned", "gloss": "This means accurately noticing and correctly interpreting internal signals like heartbeat, hunger and tiredness, and letting those inform decisions.", "antonym": "body-oblivious", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "mirror-checking", "gloss": "This means constantly picturing and mentally reviewing how one's appearance looks to oneself, often seeking flaws in thought as well as in reflection.", "antonym": "appearance-indifferent", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "spectatorial about oneself", "gloss": "This means picturing one's body from an outside observer's viewpoint, imagining how it is seen rather than how it feels from within.", "antonym": "inhabiting one's body", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "inhabiting one's body", "gloss": "This means thinking from within felt bodily experience, treating the body as the place one lives rather than an object to judge.", "antonym": "spectatorial about oneself", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "catastrophizing pain", "gloss": "This means mentally magnifying discomfort, dwelling on it and assuming it will get worse or never end.", "antonym": "matter-of-fact about pain", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "matter-of-fact about pain", "gloss": "This means thinking of discomfort as plain information to be assessed calmly, without dread or dramatic interpretation.", "antonym": "catastrophizing pain", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "calorie-counting mindset", "gloss": "This means mentally converting food and movement into numbers and running a constant tally of intake against expenditure.", "antonym": "intuitive about eating", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "intuitive about eating", "gloss": "This means trusting inner cues of hunger and fullness in thought, without rules or tallies about what or how much to eat.", "antonym": "calorie-counting mindset", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "body-as-machine thinking", "gloss": "This means treating the body as an instrument to optimize, tune and push for output, valuing it by performance.", "antonym": "inhabiting one's body", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "body-distrusting", "gloss": "This means assuming one's body is unreliable or likely to betray, and doubting its signals, strength and healing.", "antonym": "trusting one's body", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "trusting one's body", "gloss": "This means expecting the body to cope, recover and signal honestly, and thinking of it as an ally.", "antonym": "body-distrusting", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "ageing-averse", "gloss": "This means reading every wrinkle, ache or slowdown as evidence of decline and thinking about time as loss written on the body.", "antonym": "at ease with ageing", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "symptom-googling", "gloss": "This means turning bodily oddities into research questions, searching for explanations and reading meaning into every possible cause.", "antonym": "unworried about symptoms", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "mind-over-body dismissive", "gloss": "This means believing signals of tiredness or pain can be overridden by willpower and treating them as excuses to be ignored.", "antonym": "heeding bodily limits", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "heeding bodily limits", "gloss": "This means reasoning from the body's signals of strain and fatigue when planning, and counting them as real constraints.", "antonym": "mind-over-body dismissive", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.06},
{"label": "somatizing", "gloss": "This means tending to experience and explain emotional or social troubles as physical symptoms, thinking of distress in bodily terms.", "antonym": "psychologizing", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.07},
{"label": "comparing one's body", "gloss": "This means automatically measuring one's shape, strength or looks against other people's in thought, and ranking oneself accordingly.", "antonym": "self-referenced about the body", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1}
]}

user:
Domain: the body. Mode: a speech style.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to the body, each in the form of a speech style (a way the person speaks, as opposed to an attitude they hold, something they do as a rule, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read this as speech styles that show how a person relates to the body: how they talk about their own or others' bodies, their pain, health, appearance, aging, and bodily functions. I included both admirable and unflattering styles, and some that have no single word.",
"items": [
{"label": "euphemistic about bodily functions", "gloss": "This means they use soft roundabout phrases and avoid plain words when speaking of the toilet, sex, or other bodily matters.", "antonym": "plain-spoken about bodily functions", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "scatological", "gloss": "This means they pepper talk with crude jokes and vivid references to excrement, gas, and other messy bodily processes.", "antonym": "delicate in speech", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "recites ailments", "gloss": "This means they give long inventories of their aches, symptoms, and treatments whenever the chance arises, often unprompted.", "antonym": "never mentions ailments", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "understates pain", "gloss": "This means they describe serious hurt or illness in a few dry, minimizing words, saying things like 'a bit sore'.", "antonym": "dramatizes symptoms", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "dramatizes symptoms", "gloss": "This means they describe small discomforts in vivid, alarming language, as if a headache were a crisis.", "antonym": "understates pain", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "boasts about fitness", "gloss": "This means they work their running times, lifting numbers, or athletic feats into talk to show off their physical condition.", "antonym": "plays down physical prowess", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "self-deprecating about looks", "gloss": "This means they make jokes or put-downs about their own face and figure, often before anyone else could.", "antonym": "comfortable praising own looks", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.25},
{"label": "remarks on others' appearance", "gloss": "This means they readily comment aloud on how other people look, whether weight, hair, or tiredness, without being asked.", "antonym": "tactfully silent about looks", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "clinical about anatomy", "gloss": "This means they discuss flesh, illness, and death in a detached, technical register, free of embarrassment or visible feeling.", "antonym": "squeamish in speech", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": true, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "uses medical jargon", "gloss": "This means they reach for technical terms like 'myocardial' or 'idiopathic' when describing ordinary health matters, whether or not listeners follow.", "antonym": "uses lay terms for health", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "describes feelings somatically", "gloss": "This means they put emotions in terms of the body, such as a knot in the stomach, heavy limbs, or a tight chest.", "antonym": "describes feelings abstractly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.06},
{"label": "gallows humor about illness", "gloss": "This means they joke darkly about their own sickness or decline, making listeners laugh and wince at once.", "antonym": "solemn about illness", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "narrates what they eat", "gloss": "This means they keep talking about meals, calories, cravings, and food rules, making diet a constant topic.", "antonym": "silent about food", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "wry about aging", "gloss": "This means they talk about their creaking joints, graying hair, and fading memory with dry, good-natured humor.", "antonym": "evasive about age", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "overshares intimate details", "gloss": "This means they volunteer private facts about their body, such as surgeries, rashes, or sex lives, to listeners who did not ask.", "antonym": "reticent about private matters", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "sensuous in description", "gloss": "This means they speak richly of touch, taste, smell, and warmth, so that ordinary experiences sound physical and lush.", "antonym": "dry in description", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "cagey about health", "gloss": "This means they deflect or change the subject when asked how they are physically, giving little away about their condition.", "antonym": "open about health", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.05},
{"label": "speaks of body mechanically", "gloss": "This means they talk about themselves as a machine to be tuned, using terms like fuel, output, maintenance, and repair.", "antonym": "speaks of body tenderly", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.04}
]}

user:
Domain: knowledge. Mode: a speech style.
Name 15 to 20 traits that are specifically about how a person relates to knowledge, each in the form of a speech style (a way the person speaks, as opposed to an attitude they hold, something they do as a rule, a feeling they tend to have, a way they think, a moral stance they take, or a strategy they use with other people). Include admirable and unadmirable ones, and ones with no common single word.

For each item also give "probability": your estimate, between 0 and 1, of how likely you would have been to name this item if asked this question with no further guidance. Spread the items over the range; do not give every item the same number.
text:
{"approach": "I read this as how a person's relationship to knowledge shows in the way they talk: how they package, claim, qualify, source or show off what they know. I tried to go past the obvious (pedantic, pontificating) toward styles that have no single common word.", "items": [
{"label": "pedantic", "gloss": "This means correcting small errors of detail or wording in conversation, even when they do not matter to the point being made.", "antonym": "easygoing about details", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.6},
{"label": "pontificating", "gloss": "This means delivering opinions and facts in a solemn, lecturing tone that leaves no room for reply or doubt.", "antonym": "tentative", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.45},
{"label": "jargon-laden", "gloss": "This means filling speech with specialist terms and insider vocabulary, even when listeners are outsiders who will not follow.", "antonym": "plain-spoken", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.35},
{"label": "didactic", "gloss": "This means turning ordinary exchanges into teaching moments, explaining step by step whether or not anyone asked.", "antonym": "content to let others find out", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.3},
{"label": "hedges every claim", "gloss": "This means wrapping nearly every statement in qualifiers such as perhaps, in some sense or I could be wrong.", "antonym": "flatly assertive", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "name-dropping", "gloss": "This means invoking famous thinkers, institutions or acquaintances in passing to signal how well read or well connected one is.", "antonym": null, "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "Socratic", "gloss": "This means answering questions with further questions, leading the listener step by step toward working out the answer alone.", "antonym": "declarative", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.2},
{"label": "freely admits ignorance", "gloss": "This means saying plainly and without embarrassment that one does not know something or has never looked into it.", "antonym": "never concedes a gap", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "info-dumping", "gloss": "This means pouring out long streams of facts on a favorite subject without checking whether the listener wants or can absorb them.", "antonym": "sparing with detail", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.15},
{"label": "bluffs with confidence", "gloss": "This means answering in a smooth authoritative tone about things one barely understands, so that gaps are never visible.", "antonym": "candid about uncertainty", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.12},
{"label": "speaks in probabilities", "gloss": "This means putting numbers or odds on claims, saying things like seventy percent likely instead of simply yes or no.", "antonym": "speaks in certainties", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "well-actually corrector", "gloss": "This means opening replies with a correction of someone's casual statement, often on a technicality that changes little.", "antonym": "lets slips pass", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "gnomic", "gloss": "This means speaking in short, cryptic, proverb-like remarks that sound wise but leave listeners to work out the meaning.", "antonym": "explicit", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "allusive", "gloss": "This means referring indirectly to books, history or myth and expecting listeners to catch the reference without it being named.", "antonym": "literal-minded", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.1},
{"label": "explains by analogy", "gloss": "This means making hard ideas clear through homely comparisons, such as likening an economy to a bathtub or a household.", "antonym": "explains in abstract terms", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "separates fact from conjecture", "gloss": "This means marking aloud which statements are established, which are inferred and which are mere guesses as one goes along.", "antonym": "blurs known and guessed", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.08},
{"label": "vague about sources", "gloss": "This means backing claims with phrases like studies show or experts say without ever saying which studies or experts.", "antonym": "exact about sources", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.07},
{"label": "belabors the obvious", "gloss": "This means spelling out points everyone already grasps, at length and with the air of imparting something new.", "antonym": "skips what is understood", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.05},
{"label": "learnedly digressive", "gloss": "This means wandering off into fascinating side facts and history so that the original question is reached late or never.", "antonym": "sticks to the point", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.05},
{"label": "self-deprecating about expertise", "gloss": "This means brushing off real learning with remarks like I only dabble, while still speaking from deep understanding.", "antonym": "boasts of learning", "kind": "trait", "ambiguity_flag": false, "probability": 0.03}
]}

Domain: the past. Mode: an attitude.
